text: •  APPLICANTS WITH A NATIONAL SENIOR CERTIFICATE OBTAINED IN OR AFTER
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: IN NATED 191: N4:
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Admission requirement(s): An N4 Certificate in a related Engineering field as
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: published  in  Nated  191:  N4  issued  by  both  the  Department  of  Higher  Educa-
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]
["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]
["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Admission requirement(s): A National Senior Certificate with a higher certifi-
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: cate  endorsement,  or  an  equivalent  qualification,  with  an  achievement  level
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: of  at  least  3  for  English  (home  language  or  first  additional  language),  3  for
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Mathematics or Technical Mathematics (or 6 for Mathematical Literacy) and 3
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: for Physical Sciences or Technical Sciences.
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Selection criteria: To be considered for this qualification, applicants must have
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: an Admission Point Score (APS) of at least 18 (with Mathematics or Technical
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Mathematics) or 21 (with Mathematical Literacy). Life Orientation is excluded
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: from the APS calculation.
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Assessment procedures: Applicants with a score of 18 and more will be consid-
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: ered for admission.
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: •  APPLICANTS WITH A NATIONAL CERTIFICATE (VOCATIONAL) AT NQF LEVEL 4:
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Admission  requirement(s):  A  National  Certificate  (Vocational)  at  NQF  Level
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: 4  with  a  higher  certificate  endorsement,  with  at  least  50%  for  English  (first
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: additional  language)  and  50%  Mathematics  or  70%  for  Mathematical  Literacy,
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: and 50% for Sciences, and 40% for Life Orientation (excluded for APS calcula-
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: tion) and 50% for any two vocational subjects.
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Selection criteria: To be considered for this qualification, applicants must have
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: an Admission Point Score (APS) of at least 18 (with Mathematics) or 21 (with
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Mathematical Literacy). Life Orientation is excluded from the APS calculation.
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Assessment  procedure(s):  Applicants  with  a  score  of  18  and  more  will  be
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: considered for admission.
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: •  FOR APPLICANTS WITH A FURTHER EDUCATION AND TRAINING CERTIFICATE

text: (NQF LEVEL 4):
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: A  Further  Education  and  Training  Certificate:  Water  and  Wastewater  Treat-
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: ment Process Control Supervision or any other equivalent qualification at NQF
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Level 4.
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Intake for the qualification: January only.
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Presentation: Day and block-mode classes (block-mode classes are only offered
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: to students who are employed).
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Minimum duration: A minimum of one or two years depending on the program-
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: ming offering.
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Closing date for application: 30 September.
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Possible further studies: Dip (Water Science and Technology).
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: Possible careers: Water care technician, water care technologist and process
section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: controller.

section_path: ["Contents", "Faculty of Science"]

text: subjects.

text: Selection criteria: To be considered for this qualification, applicants must have

text: 1.  Although the information in this Prospectus has been compiled as accurately as possible, the Council
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: accepts no responsibility for any inaccuracies in this publication. This Prospectus is valid for 2026 only.

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 3.  Prospective students will not be admitted to any qualification without prior evaluation.

text: 4.  The indicated non-refundable administration fee and certified copies of the applicant's identity document,

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: completed application form or online application.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 5.  The closing dates for admissions are available on the University website.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 6.  A student must complete a qualification at the learning site where he/she was accepted and is registered.

text: A transfer between sites will only be allowed if the student follows the following process:

text: A formal request must be submitted to the academic manager/Head of the Department on the cur-

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: year) or the second Friday in October (to be considered for a transfer in January of the following
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: year). The request must contain the reasons for the transfer.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A committee will meet shortly after each of the closing dates for submissions to consider every
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: The goals and functions of universities of technology are unique. Universities of technology, being duly con-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: cerned about the country’s need for human resources, have as their chief objective the provision of training
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: and education at a tertiary level for the application of technology in the work situation. The primary functions
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: of a university of technology can be summarised as follows:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: A university of technology strives not only towards the promotion of knowledge and skills, but also, especially,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: towards the application of such knowledge and the development and releasing of means for the application
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: of that knowledge in the training of manpower, emphasising the practical and the vocational. As a result of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: rapid progress in the fields of technology and science, continuous interaction between vocational education
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: and its practical application is absolutely essential. This is why a sound relationship is maintained between the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: various universities of technology, on the one hand, and between the universities of technology and commerce,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: industry and the government sector, on the other hand. Employers, businessmen and industrialists play an
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: important role in the management and counselling structures of universities of technology.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: It is the task of a university of technology to train students as thoroughly as possible in specific professions
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: through  combining  study  and  practical  work  experience  (cooperative  education).  The  emphasis  is  on  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: practical application of knowledge and skills.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: The formal side of vocational education is continuously being put to the test in the practical work situation. For
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: this reason, the principle of cooperative education constantly receives attention. At a university of technology,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: students therefore alternate their studies with the application  of their acquired knowledge and skills in the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: work situation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: A  university  of  technology,  being  an  educational  institution,  is  also  responsible  for  educating  and  forming
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: students. The psychological, moral, cultural, social and physical development of the student is emphasised to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: enable him or her to take his or her place in the community as a well-equipped expert in his or her profession.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: You are expected to enjoy your life as a student. You are, however, also expected to do this in a way worthy
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: of the objectives of the Tshwane University of Technology.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "OBJECTIVES OF A UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY"]

text: As stated in rule 1.3.3, prospective students will not be admitted to any qualification without prior evaluation.

text: APPLICATION FOR ADMISSION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: A prospective student shall apply on the required application form for admission to a qualification.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: A prospective student is regarded as someone wishing to study at TUT for the first time.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Application forms for admission to TUT are available on request from the Information offices at the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: different campuses.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: No prospective student shall be permitted to study for any qualification without prior evaluation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: The closing date for all applications, which should be submitted with the required administration
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: fee, is 31 July of the preceding year of study in the case of year qualifications and qualifications
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: commencing  in  the  first  semester.  However,  applications  for  some  specialisation  qualifications
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: close on 15 June, as do all international applications. For qualifications commencing in the second
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: semester, the closing date is 15 May of the proposed year of study.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Closing dates for applications for distance education students: 30 November for the January intake
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: with a May examination and, if applicable, 15 May for the July intake with a November examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: The application form should be accompanied by a certified copy of the applicant’s National Senior
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Certificate or an equivalent qualification, as well as any other documents required for admission to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: the qualification for which he or she intends to enrol.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: PLEASE NOTE:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: TUT shall accept as correct only the spelling and sequence of the student’s surname and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: first names appearing on the document required for admission to TUT to study for his or her
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: proposed certificate, diploma or degree.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: A married woman shall submit a certified copy of her marriage certificate (or divorce order,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: where applicable), should any of her certificates have been issued in her maiden name.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Chapter 1
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Other names and/or spellings shall be accepted only on receipt of a certificate duly amended
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: by the Department of Education or other institution that had issued it, or after receiving proof
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: that the student’s surname and/or first names have been officially changed. Such proof should
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: be supplied or issued by the Department of Home Affairs or, where applicable, a similar body,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: and should indicate the student’s date of birth, his or her former names and his or her present
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: names. Sworn statements, birth certificates, passports and/or identity documents are NOT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: acceptable for this purpose.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Prospective students who have obtained qualifications outside the Republic of South Africa
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: are advised to contact the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) beforehand to have
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: their qualifications evaluated.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Prospective students who have obtained their qualifications from a recognised private school-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: ing system in South Africa may apply to the Office of the Registrar for admission via a Senate
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: discretionary  route  as  an  interim  arrangement  until  full  accreditation  is  achieved  by  such
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: schools. The Registrar will consider conditional admission and submit a list of conditionally
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: accepted candidates for Senate approval.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: A  statement  of  symbols  will  be  accepted  provisionally  until  a  certified  copy  of  the  original
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: National Senior Certificate is handed in.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: If an applicant’s previous registration had been at any other tertiary educational institution where
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: he or she discontinued his or her studies before obtaining the degree or diploma he or she had
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: been registered for, he or she has to submit, as soon as possible, an original academic record and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: a certificate of good conduct issued by the registrar of that institution.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: If the applicant had previously been registered at more than one tertiary educational institution, he
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: or she has to obtain the documents referred to in rule 1.3.5 from each of those institutions, where
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: applicable. Please note that TUT will keep those original documents and that they will not be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: returned to the applicant.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: PROVISIONAL ADMISSION IN RESPECT OF WORK EXPERIENCE, AGE AND MATURITY
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: A person may also, subject to rule 1.1.1 or rule 1.2.1, be provisionally admitted if such a person
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: is in possession of a National Senior Certificate, Senior Certificate or an equivalent certificate, but
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: lacks more than one requirement for admission, provided that –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: (a)  such a person should have reached the age of 23 before the date of registration and should
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: have at least three (3) years of work experience and proven ability relating to the proposed
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: field of study; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: the TUT Council is satisfied that the standard of such a person’s communication skills, his or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: her ability to study successfully and his or her work experience are such that he or she will
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: be able to complete the proposed qualification successfully.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: A person who has been admitted in respect of work experience, age and maturity, shall be admitted
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: to the second semester or year only if his or her academic achievement in the first semester or year
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: of study has been to the satisfaction of the Council.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: A person who is admitted to the second semester or year of study shall be regarded as having met
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: the minimum requirements for admission to studies at TUT.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), equivalence and status - refer to Chapter 30.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Chapter 1
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: REQUIREMENTS FOR APPLICANTS WHO OBTAINED A NATIONAL CERTIFICATE (VOCA-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: TIONAL) LEVEL 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: No person may be registered as a student at TUT to study for a qualification or a subdivision of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: a qualification unless he or she has obtained a National Certificate (Vocational) (Level 4) (NC(V)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Level 4) with a minimum of 50% in the language of learning and teaching of the higher education
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: institution, as certified by the Council for Quality Assurance in General and Further Education and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Training (Umalusi):
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Provided that the subjects passed for the National Certificate (Vocational) (NC(V) at NQF
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Level 4) or a certificate contemplated in the said rule are subjects passed on the required
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: levels; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: ii.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Provided further that a prospective student be admitted if he or she has obtained a National
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Certificate Vocational (NQF Level 4) with a minimum of six subjects subject to minimum re-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: quirements below, including English (first additional language with a minimum score of 4),
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Mathematics or Mathematical Literacy (as per specific academic programme requirement)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: and the further subjects required by a specific academic programme (Life Orientation will
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: not be included in the calculation of Admission Point Score). The applications must meet
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: the minimum requirements required to the national standard for the higher certificate, natio-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: nal higher certificate, national diploma, diploma and bachelor’s degrees.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: The minimum requirements are the following:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: For the higher certificate, subject to the TUT admission requirements and compliance with the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: requirements for English (home or first additional language).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: For the diploma, subject to the TUT admission requirements and achieving at least 40% in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: three fundamental subjects, which include English (home or first additional language), and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: at least 50% in three compulsory vocational subjects.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: For the bachelor's degree, subject to the TUT admission requirements and achieving at
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: least 50% in three fundamental subjects, which include English (home or first additional
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: language), and at least 60% in four vocational subjects.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: The three (3) fundamental subjects are English (first additional language), Mathematics or Mathe-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: matical Literacy and Life Orientation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: REQUIREMENTS FOR SENIOR STUDENTS FROM OTHER UNIVERSITIES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Applicants will be considered if:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: They have an endorsed national senior certificate for a programme at the same level as
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: the programme that they are applying for; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: ii.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: They have demonstrated competence during their first level of study at the other higher edu-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: cation institution they are transferring from. Competence is determined at the discretion of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Senate. Senate discretionary admission should only apply in instances where applicants who,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: in the opinion of Senate have demonstrated, in the approved selection process, that they
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: are suitable for admission to programmes for which they have the required endorsement. All
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Senate discretionary admissions should be approved by Senate or a committee with delega-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: ted authority or powers to consider such admissions on behalf of Senate. The following guide-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: line shall apply:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: The applicant should have passed the national senior certificate with an endorse-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: ment of a bachelor's degree or diploma or a higher certificate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: (ii)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: The applicant should have completed at least the full first year of study of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: qualification he or she wishes to register for.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: (iii)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: For applicants who have completed more than 50% of their qualification at another
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: university, the 50% exemption rule is still applicable.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: Chapter 1
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: (iv)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: The Executive Committee of the Faculty Board concerned will be competent to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: apply this rule with Senate's ratification.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: The other option is RPL. Please refer to Chapter 30 for the process.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: admission should only apply in instances where applicants who, in the opinion of Senate

text: have  demonstrated  in  the  approved  selection  process  that  they  are  suitable  for  admis-

text: sion to programmes for which they have the required endorsement. All Senate discretionary
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: powers to consider such admissions on behalf of Senate.

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: or she has to notify the Admissions Office in writing.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: supplied by anyone who has not been authorised to supply such information. All enquiries should
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 1"]

text: be directed to the Admissions Office.

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: The purpose of exclusion is due to the following reasons:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: To increase access
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: The Department of Higher Education and Training’s (DHET) enrolment plan caps the number of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: funded full-time equivalent students enrolled at public tertiary institutions. Poor performing students,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: therefore, deny space to new entrants, straining access to the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: For financial viability
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Poor performing students hamper throughput. A lower success rate has implicit reputational risks
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: and diminishes earnings from teaching output units.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: To sustain academic reputation
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: If poor performing students are allowed to stay in the system, there will be a constant growth in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: student numbers which -
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: •   cannot be accommodated in laboratories and other facilities already overburdened;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: •  compromise the quality of the teaching and learning of all other students; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: •  negatively impact on the accreditation of qualifications by professional and other accreditation
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: bodies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Chapters 1 & 2
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: DEFINITIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: In this chapter, unless otherwise indicated –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: “Academic Exclusion” at TUT refers to readmission refusal from a specific qualification,department
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: or faculty for a set period of time due to the student's failure to comply with the minimum progress
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: requirements as described in this policy. The exclusion may be in the form of:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (a)  Exclusion from a specific academic qualification, in which case the student may be eligible for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: admission in another academic qualification within the same department, faculty or in another
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: faculty at TUT and need to meet the minimum admission requirement.  Such admission should
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: take into account the student enrolment plan of that faculty/department as approved by DHET.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (b)   Exclusion from the faculty in which case the student may be eligible to be admitted in another
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: academic qualification in another faculty at TUT. Such candidates may be referred to Student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Development and Support (SDS) directorate for career counselling and will need to meet the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: admission requirement for the alternative academic qualification selected.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: “Academic Intervention” refers to programme, supportive or developmental action before exclu-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: sion takes place, either prescribed (compulsory) or recommended (voluntary) by the department
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: or faculty. Such interventions can also be prescribed or recommended by Student Development
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Development and Support directorate on behalf of the department or faculty.  Academic interven
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: tions may take place before exclusion or as an exclusion or probation condition.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: “Academic Performance” is the relative success or failure of a student to comply with the require-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: ments of the academic qualification for which he or she is registered, within the limited time pre-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: scribed for the qualification.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: “Academic Probation” refers to conditional grace period in the exclusion process which provides
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: the student the opportunity, through specific conditions and interventions, to comply with the aca-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: demic performance requirements, in order to avoid final exclusion.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: “Academic Qualification(s)” refers to learning programmes that lead to qualifications described in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: the various parts of the official Prospectus of TUT. For the purpose of this policy, qualifications are
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: divided into two groups:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (a)  All undergraduate and postgraduate qualifications that are based on the accumulation of credits
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: and has a clearly defined structure based on module/s to be passed before the qualification
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: can be awarded (this includes structured master’s degrees).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (b)  Research-based postgraduate master’s and doctoral degrees.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: “Re-admission to studies” referts to specified scenarios where students who appealed are granted
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: permission by the Faculty Academic Exclusion Appeals Committee (FAEAC) to register for the next
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: academic term or who after a period of two years are granted permission by the head of the depart-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: ment to register via the readmission process.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Financial viability: Poor performing students hamper throughput. A lower success rate has implicit
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: reputational risks and diminishes earnings from teaching output units.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.3  Academic reputation: If poor performing students are allowed to stay in the system, there will be a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: constant growth in student numbers, which:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (a)  cannot be accommodated in laboratories and other facilities already overburdened;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (b)  compromise the quality of the teaching and learning of all other students; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (c)  negatively impact on the accreditation of qualifications by professional and other accreditation
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: bodies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.4  Documented records of poor class and/or tutorial attendance/participation may be used as evidence
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: during an exclusion meeting.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: The guiding principle is that a full-time student is allowed twice the minimum duration of a qualifica-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: tion. For example, a maximum of six years to complete a three-year qualification, two years for a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: one-year qualification, and eight years for a four-year degree.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Chapter 2
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Evening-class, part-time, block or distant education students and students who annually register for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: fewer than the required number of modules and who submit valid reasons, will be considered for a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: proportionally extended time period in order to complete the qualification.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: These rules enables TUT to, where possible, identify and refer students for various interventions to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: improve their academic performance in order to avoid exclusion.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: To reduce exclusions of first-year students, an evaluation after the first test/assessment will lead to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: three types of interventions for poor-performing students (high risk students):
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (a) compulsory tutorial attendance,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (b) 50% reduction of their load at the end of the semester, and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (c) the process of exclusions or interventions should begin earlier to allow students to register for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: other programmes.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.9  Students  may  submit  an  appeal  on  the  prescribed  appeal  application  form  to  the  Departmental
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Acacemic Excultion Appleals Commitee (DAEAC), providing complete evidence of aspects to be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: considered for re-admission. The DAEAC will make a recommendation based on the portfolio of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: evidence available and this may include records of interventions attended at the Student Develop-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: ment and Support (SDS) directorate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.10  The DAEAC will prepare a complete record of appeal applications and recommendations. This is
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: to be recorded on the prescribed template provided by the Registrar’s Office and submitted to the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: FAEAC for approval. Both the DAEAC and FAEAC will utilise the guidelines for special considera
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: tions and extenuating circumstances.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.11  The FAEAC will make a final decision and record it in the prescribed format and submit decisions
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: to  the  SDS  directorate  and  Registrar’s  Office.  These  decisions  are  final  and  no  further  appeal,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: whether on departmental, faculty or institutional level, will be considered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.12  The  Registrar’s  Office  will  officially  communicate  the  outcome  to  the  student  and  the  academic
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: department will provide written feedback to a re-admitted student, clearly stipulating all conditions.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Should the condition include referral to the SDS directorate, it is the responsibility of the student to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: contact the SDS directorate to schedule an appointment in this regard, upon which the letter from
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: the Department/Faculty accompany the student and be presented at the SDS directorate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.13  Students who change from one qualification to another in a different faculty will have the same
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: maximum time as other first-time entering students in the same qualification. If the student registers
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: for a different qualification in the same faculty, the maximum period will be decreased proportionally
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: with the time required to pass modules common to the two qualifications.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.14   A single uniform exclusion approach, with standard operating procedures and guidelines, shall be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: applied throughout the institution by all faculties and campuses of TUT.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.15   Students who are excluded may only apply for readmission to the same qualification after a period
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: of one year. After readmission, students should be provided with:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (a)  proactive counselling,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (b)  career testing, and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (c)  active developmental or support programmes.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.16  Appeals of exclusions received before the end of the one-year exclusion period will only be con
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: sidered by the DAEAC and FAEAC, if proof of academic success or development can be provided.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.17   Application for readmission after a one-year period should go the normal route of admission before
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: the closing date for admissions.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Chapter 2
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.1.18  Closing dates for appeals, according to the academic core calendar, will be strictly applied. If a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: student has neglected to appeal in time, such an appeal will only be considered during the appeal
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: process of the next academic term.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: SPECIFIC  RULES  FOR  THE ADMINISTRATION  OF  PROBATION AND  EXCLUSION-BASED
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: DECISIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Probation students who did not fulfil their probation requirements will be excluded and will not be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: able to appeal any further.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: A student who achieves 50% or more of the maximum number of credits required after each year
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: of  study  may  proceed  uninterrupted. The  maximum  number  of  credits  for  each  year  of  study  is
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: specified in the Prospectus.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: A student who achieves more than 30% (this percentage will gradually increase after the second
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: year  (see Tables  1  –  4)  but  less  than  50%  of  the  maximum  number  of  credits  for  the  specified
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: period of study will be placed on academic probation. Students on probation are informed by the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: academic  department  in  writing  and  are  referred  to  the  SDS  directorate  for  counselling  and/or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: academic interventions. The Department may further set compulsory conditions for the student to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: continue with his/her academic qualification. It is highly recommended that faculties monitor the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: process, specifically for first-year students, after one semester and introduce academic interventions
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: where feasible to avoid probation or even exclusion.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: 2.5.2.4  A  student  who  has  been  previously  placed  on  academic  probation  and  achieves  less  than  30%
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: (this percentage will gradually increase after the second year – see Tables 1 – 4) of the maximum
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: credits for the specific period will be excluded from further study, but may appeal based on evidence
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: of extenuating circumstances and proof of completed academic interventions recommended during
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: the probation period, if applicable.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: A student, who has failed the same module during two different study periods, will be placed on
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: probation. Failing that same module(s) on a third attempt, will result in exclusion with the right to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: appeal.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: A student who has previously been placed on probation, but will not be able to complete the re-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: mainder  of  the  course  in  the  maximum  allowable  time,  even  if  taking  a  maximum  load,  will  be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: excluded. The student may appeal based on evidence of extenuating circumstances and proof of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: completed academic interventions recommended during the probation period.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Students will only be readmitted on certain conditions.
