text: GENERAL RULES AND PRINCIPLES FOR STUDENTS REGISTERED FOR RESEARCH POST-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: GRADUATE QUALIFICATIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Academic probation is not applicable to postgraduate students.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: The period of study allowed for a research master’s degree is a minimum of one (1) year and a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: maximum of three (3) years.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: The period of study for a doctoral degree is a minimum of two (2) years and a maximum of five (5)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: academic years.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: A student who has already been registered for the maximum number of years and who has not yet
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: completed his/her studies will only be re-admitted after a successful appeal against his/her exclu-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: sion.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: The student needs to submit his/her appeal to his/her research supervisor.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: The supervisor, in consultation with the head of the department, compiles a recommendation for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: the Faculty Postgraduate Exclusion Appeals Committee (FPGEAC) for consideration of re-admission.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: The committee will consider the application based on the reasons provided by the student, past
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: progress and the possibility that the student will complete the qualification by the end of the following
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: year.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Extension of the study period can only be for a period of one year. However, students may appeal
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: again for further extension.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: There  will  be  no  official  closing  date  to  submit  appeals,  however,  a  student  must  appeal  within
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: fourteen (14) days after he/she has been notified of his/her exclusion.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: Students will only be readmitted on certain conditions.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 2"]

text: CHAPTER 3
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: REGISTRATION OF STUDENTS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Please note:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Students who have not yet submitted a certified copy of their National Senior Certificate (Grade 12) or equi-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: valent qualification, or a certified copy of the symbols they obtained for either qualification, should do so prior
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to registration or on registration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: DEFINITIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In this chapter, unless otherwise indicated –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A “full-time student” is a student whose main activity during the day is the full-time attendance
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of classes according to a formal class attendance timetable. Work-Integrated Learning (WIL) may
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: form part of the programme requirements.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapters 2 & 3
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A  “part-time  student”  is  a  student  whose  main  daily  activity  is  not  the  full-time  attendance  of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: classes, but who attends classes in the evenings according to an alternative class timetable. The
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: duration of the curriculum could extend past the minimum duration prescribed for a full-time student.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: WIL may form part of the programme requirements.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A “block-mode student” refers to a student who attends classes as one of a designated group of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: students for a continuous period of one to eight weeks according to an alternative class timetable.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Classes may also be offered on Saturdays, and block programmes can be offered on campus or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: at an approved off-campus site. WIL may form part of the programme requirements.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: FORMAL INSTRUCTION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Students must register for each academic term (annually, in the case of year programmes, and each
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: semester, in the case of semester programmes) in the set registration periods, and they must pay
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the required initial fees. Students will not be permitted to register after the final date of registration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: After the closing date for registration, disciplinary steps will be taken against students who attend
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: classes before they have been officially registered, and they will be subject to a fine.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: If, on registration, a student is unable to submit certified copies of the documentary proof that all the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: admission requirements have been met, he or she may register conditionally: provided that, if TUT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: does not receive the documents concerned before 30 April (in the case of first-semester and year
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: students) or before 31 August (in the case of second-semester students), the student’s registration
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: for the academic term concerned be cancelled immediately and any fees paid be forfeited.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In  cases  where TUT  receives  the  above  documents  before  30 April  or  31 August,  but  after  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: student has registered, and it is subsequently found that the student was not entitled to register
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: for the programme concerned, his or her registration for the academic term concerned shall be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: cancelled immediately and any fees paid shall be forfeited.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Registration as a student is valid for one (1) academic year only in the case of year programmes
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: and for one (1) semester only in the case of semester programmes. This also applies to WIL.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: On his or her signing of the registration form or acceptance of the electronic declaration in respect
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of an academic term, a student declares him- or herself fully conversant with the rules of TUT, and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: he or she undertakes to observe, strictly, all the rules of TUT. If he or she is a minor but is not being
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: assisted by a parent or guardian, it is accepted by implication that he or she has been authorised
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to sign the registration form. Fees are not refundable in cases of expulsion or suspension or if a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: student no longer attends lectures.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Particulars  regarding  dates  of  registration  and  other  relevant  information  are  posted/mailed  to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: newcomer students and are also obtainable from Academic Administration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The registration of students of the various academic departments takes place on different dates
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: and campuses, and students must attend lectures on the dates determined by the heads of their
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: respective academic departments, irrespective of whether or not their registration has been formally
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: concluded. Official registration takes place at Academic Administration or at the official registration
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: points. Enrolment at any academic department, the payment of class fees or the making of arrange-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: ments for the payment of class fees does not exempt a student from official registration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The registration form contains all the modules/subjects for which a student may register for the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: period concerned, and no one will be admitted to register for a module/subject unless the Head
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of the Department concerned, or his or her delegate approves the student’s choice of modules/
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: subjects.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Please note that after the closing date for registration, no student will be allowed to attend classes
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: if he or she is not formally registered and cannot produce proof of registration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapter 3
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: No student will be permitted to register at TUT for more than one (1) certificate, diploma or degree
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: programme, simultaneously, in any given academic year or semester, without the permission of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the Registrar, and no student may register at more than one (1) institution for tertiary education,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: simultaneously,  without  the  permission  of  the  Registrar.  Such  permission  may  be  withdrawn  by
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the Registrar on recommendation of the Head of the Department concerned, should the academic
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: performance of the student not be satisfactory. A student who has obtained permission must famil-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: iarise him- or herself with all the relevant examination dates before registering at another tertiary
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: education institution. Should the simultaneous registration result in the coinciding of examination
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: dates, the student shall not be permitted to register for the subject(s)/module(s) concerned at the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: other institution. TUT shall neither consider nor accommodate any other examination date(s) for such
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: subject(s)/module(s) if examination dates should coincide as a result of simultaneous registration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Registration for two (2) programmes, without the written approval of the Registrar, does not imply
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: consent, and such registration may be cancelled.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: No student will be permitted to register for a module/subject without having passed the relevant
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: module/subject  in  the  preceding  year  or  semester,  and/or  the  prerequisite  subject(s)/module(s)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: for admission to that subject(s)/module(s). Registration for a module/subject or modules/subjects
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: contrary to this rule does not imply that TUT condones such registration. Any inadmissible regi-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: stration will be cancelled without prior notice, as soon as it is discovered. Should a module/subject
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: credit be obtained by means of such inadmissible registration, the student concerned may lay no
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: claim to such credit, and the Registrar has the right to cancel that credit. All class fees paid shall
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: be forfeited in such a case.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 3.1.10  When a student registers for a certificate, diploma, advanced diploma, postgraduate diploma  or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: degree programme, such registration is subject to the rules in terms of which the curriculum con-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: cerned has been drawn up and approved by the Council on the recommendation of the Senate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Should the rules in terms of which a curriculum has been drawn up be amended, students who com-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: menced their studies under previous rules and who have not interrupted their studies, may, subject
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to the transitional provisions formulated or confirmed by the Council, complete their curriculum in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: terms of the former rules: provided that the TUT Council formulate transitional rules to enable such
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: students to complete their studies within a reasonable period in terms of the former rules.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The TUT Council reserves the right to discontinue the offering of any approved programme at any
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: time and to authorise the offering of any new, approved programme and any reviewed, approved
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: programme, at any time.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A student must determine him- or herself whether the programme for which he or she has enrolled
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: has been reviewed. If it has been reviewed, he or she should find out what the teach-out (phase-out)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: date is of the programme he or she is currently attending, and whether he or she would be able to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: meet all the requirements for graduation, in time – before the teach-out (phase-out) date.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A student who has registered for a certificate, diploma or degree programme and who fails to renew
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: his or her registration for that programme in the following academic semester or year, or who fails
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: a term of study, will be deemed to have interrupted his or her studies and will forfeit the right to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: complete his or her studies in terms of the former rules: provided that registration for Work-Integrated
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Learning for the academic term following the term in question be regarded as a renewal of his or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: her registration: provided further that the TUT Council, in exceptional cases, should permit such
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: a student to continue his or her studies in terms of such conditions as may be determined by the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Council.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: If a student is unable to comply with all the requirements before the teach-out (phase-out) date, he
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: or she has to change over to the reviewed programme and has to apply to Academic Administration
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: for exemption from the applicable modules/subjects for which he or she has already obtained credit.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Subsequently, that student will have to meet the requirements he or she has not yet met in respect
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of the reviewed programme, in terms of the rules of the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapter 3
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: If a student fails a module/subject and wishes to register for that module/subject again, he or she may
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: do so only if the examination timetable can accommodate that combination of registered modules/
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: subjects within the set period of examination without any examination dates for those modules/
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: subjects coinciding.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: TUT assumes no responsibility for any incorrect information in respect of any matter relating to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: registration supplied by anyone who has not been authorised to supply such information. All enqui-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: ries should be directed to Academic Administration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: LATE REGISTRATION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A student who does not register in the official period of registration will not be allowed to register in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: that particular semester or year.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Students who, for whatever reason, register after classes have commenced, may not lay claim to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: any concession regarding lectures, tests, etc. that took place before they registered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: PROOF OF REGISTRATION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: It is the responsibility of each student to ensure that his or her registration has been carried out
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: correctly and that he or she receives an official proof of registration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: All students are provided with proof of registration on conclusion of their registration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Students must verify that the information given for proof of registration is correct before the end of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: registration period. All changes or corrections must be reported before the final, published registra-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: tion date. Should a student fail to do so, cancellations and additions that follow after that date will
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: not be considered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: International students may register at TUT if they are in possession of a valid study permit or a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: study visa. All other registration rules apply to all international students (refer to Chapter 17).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: CHAPTER 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: EXAMINATION RULES AND REGULATIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: STUDENT EXAMINATION RULES AND REGULATIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: All  the  rules  under  rule  4.1  shall  apply  to  distance  education  students,  except  where  indicated
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: otherwise.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: INTRODUCTION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The examinations of the Tshwane University of Technology (TUT) are conducted in terms of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: provisions of the Higher Education Act, 1997 (Act No. 101 of 1997), and the statutes of TUT, and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: according to TUT’s rules and regulations, as approved by the Council and/or the Senate of TUT.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Students who do not comply with these rules and regulations shall be subjected to disciplinary steps.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: DEFINITIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In this chapter, unless otherwise indicated –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Academic Core Calendar” means a published list of TUT academic activities and dates as ap-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: proved by Senate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapters 3 & 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: "Assessment" is the systematic evaluation of a student’s ability to demonstrate the achievement
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of the learning goals intended in a curriculum.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Assessment records” means records of the results of all assessment opportunities. These shall
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: include all official documentation affecting changes to the students’ assessment results.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Block examination” means the examination of block modules which are written outside the official
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: TUT examination date.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Disability” means the loss or elimination of opportunities to take part in the life of the community,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: equitably  with  others,  that  is  encountered  by  persons  having  physical,  sensory,  psychological,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: developmental, learning, neurological or other impairments, which may be permanent, temporary
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: or  episodic  in  nature;  thereby  causing  activity  limitations  and  participation  restriction  within  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: mainstream society.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Examination” means a component of the assessment that refers to the culmination of the sum-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: mative assessment process when students/learners are subjected to a final sitting at the end of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the learning process.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Examination  cycle”  means  the  examination  opportunities  at  the  end  of  an  academic  period.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Distance education programmes follow a different cycle.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Examination mark” means the mark obtained by the student during an examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Examination termination” means a series of assessment opportunities, which culminates in a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: predicate mark that allows admission into a final examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Exit examination” means a final examination opportunity to a final-year student who requires a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: maximum of one module in order to obtain a qualification. Non-examination modules and Work-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Integrated Learning (WIL) are excluded.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Extenuating circumstances” means circumstances and situations that prevents or prohibits a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: student to participate in assessment such as illness or any deemed unavoidable activity/situation
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: that can prevent student to participate in assessment. This needs to be ratified and validated by the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: head of academic department for tests and the Registrar’s environment for theoretical examinations.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Proof of documents needs to be provided in cases of death of close family relatives amongst others.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Final mark” means the total mark (predicate and examination marks) calculated according to a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: pre-determined formula (weighting) as published in the assessment plan that appears in the study
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: guide. In the case of non-examination termination modules, the final mark is calculated according
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to the non-examination termination assessment model selected.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: "Invigilator" means a person who supervises students during tests and examinations.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Main examination” means the examination conducted at the end of an academic block/semester/
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: year.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Moderator” means a person, apart from the examiner, who is appointed by the institution to be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: responsible for ensuring the standard of the examination and its accompanying marking framework
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: and response exemplars, and for marking a representative sample of examination responses.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Module” means an independently defined learning unit, designed to result in a specific set of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: learning outcomes, and which is a component of a programme.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapter 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Non-examination termination model” means an assessment strategy that comprises a series
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of assessment opportunities, which culminates in a final mark.  A variety of models can be used
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: depending on the purpose and outcomes of the module.  Provisional to the chosen model, a predicate
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: mark may not govern admission to the final integrated assessment opportunity.  The final mark can
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: be calculated by using the mark of only the final integrated assessment opportunity, or a combination
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of specific percentages of all the assessment opportunities and the final integrated assessment or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: an average of all the assessment opportunities.  During the final integrated assessment opportunity,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: a student is required to undertake a summative, specified, academic task.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Predicate” means the mark, earned by a registered student and expressed as a percentage, which
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: comprises the total accumulated test and other marks. It governs admission to a final examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: (Predicate is indicated as “full period mark” on Integrated Tertiary Software (ITS))
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Predicate day” means the publication date of the predicate marks of students for notification,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: possible comments and/or corrections.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Prospectus” means a formal, legal TUT publication containing statutory regulations and institu-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: tional rules regarding formal study at TUT, as well as information on programmes.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Publication schedule” means the document that governs the examination publication related
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: processes.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Special examination” means an examination granted, subject to the approval of the Registrar or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: his/her designate, to a student or group of students who were absent during the main examination,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: due to illness and extenuating circumstances.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Student” means a person registered as a student at TUT.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “Supplementary examination” means a subsequent examination opportunity following the main
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination in a module or modules granted under certain conditions, as stipulated in this policy,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to a student who failed the module or modules concerned during the preceding main examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The supplementary examination usually takes place as soon as the main examination is completed.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: "Test" means an assessment opportunity that is arranged by the lecturer and is (usually) conducted
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: during lecture periods. Non-examination terminating modules will have tests as a major assess-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: ment technique. For the purpose of this policy, test can also refer to a performance, product or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: demonstrated skill.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: “University” means the Tshwane University of Technology (TUT), as duly constituted in terms of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the provisions of the Higher Education Act, 1997 (Act No. 101 of 1997), as amended.
