text: All assessments of learning at the University shall be conducted in terms of the Higher Education
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Act, 1997 (Act No. 101 of 1997) and the statutes of the University, and according to the rules and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: regulations, as approved by the Council and/or Senate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A preliminary examination timetable will be distributed via the TUT website six (6) weeks prior to the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination for inputs.  Students’ enquiries must be directed to the academic department.  Students
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: will be notified (via a Short Message Service (SMS)/TUT Website) that the preliminary timetable is
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: available for inputs.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Academic departments are responsible for compiling and publishing examination timetables for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: block modules.  Such examination dates must be provided to the Registrar’s environment at the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: start of the academic year.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The  Registrar’s  environment  is  responsible  for  providing  students  with  the  correct  examination
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: information by publication of timetables on the TUT’s website and issuing of personal timetables
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: on request.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Only registered modules with examination admission are listed on the student's personal exami-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: nation timetable. The student must have the minimum qualifying requirements of 40% predicate
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: mark (excluding exceptions as approved by Senate) for admission to examination in any particular
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: module.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Only the examination timetables published on the TUT’s website, and the personal timetables issued
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to students by the Registrar’s environment are considered as the official examination timetable of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The Distance Education Department will post the personal student timetables to students at least
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: two (2) weeks in advance and publish it on the TUT website. TUT will not be held liable for lost or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: undelivered individual student timetables.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: TUT will not accept responsibility for incorrect information concerning examination arrangements
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: provided by unauthorised persons.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: It is the responsibility of the student to ensure that the information reflecting on his/her personal
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: timetable is correct.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The final timetable is required to be published approximately four (4) weeks prior to the commence-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: ment of examinations. Students can collect their personal timetables as from the first day of predicate
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: week from the Registrar’s environment.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The examination date, session, venue, and predicate mark must be printed next to the module on
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: each student’s personal timetable.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Examination sessions will start according to the students’ personal timetables. The first session will
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: start at 08:45 and the second session will start at 13:45.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Students will not be allowed to enter the session more than half an hour after commencement and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: no student is allowed to leave the session before half an hour has passed.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Students must be seated 15 minutes before the session commences.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapter 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Employees are not authorised to furnish examination timetable information telephonically to students.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Students can, however, view the final examination timetable on the TUT website.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Coinciding of examination dates and sessions (clashes):
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.16.1  TUT shall not take responsibility for the coinciding of examination dates and sessions due to the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: repeating of modules, although students shall be accommodated as far as possible.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.16.2  TUT shall not accommodate cases where examination dates and sessions coincide as a result of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: a simultaneous registration for another qualification, or as a result of registration at another tertiary
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: institution, or as a result of responsibilities placed on a student by, for example, an employer.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.16.3  The  following  requirements  shall  apply  if  any  examination  dates  and  times  of  a  student  should
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: coincide:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: (a)   The student has to notify the Registrar’s environment at the campus concerned of the coin-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: ciding examination dates and sessions. He/she has to complete the required form in writing
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: three (3) working days prior to the examination date concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: (b)  Guidelines  regarding  clashing  examinations  must  be  provided  to  the  students  during  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: notification process.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: (c)  Cases of coinciding examinations shall be accommodated in a separate examination venue
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: where students shall be kept under constant invigilation. Enquiries regarding the venue ar-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: rangements made to accommodate the coinciding of examinations must be made at the Re-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: g istrar’s environment early (08:00) in the morning before the examinations of the modules
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: concerned are to be written.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: (d)   All modules concerned shall be written on the same day, although during different examination
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: sessions.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Examination venue regulations:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.17.1  Modules per session are scheduled according to available venues.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.17.2   All  examinations  must  be  conducted  at  a  venue  determined  by  TUT,  and  a  student  must  write
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examinations at the venue determined for the campus where he/she is registered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The following rules are applicable to students with disabilities:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.18.1  Students with disabilities (as defined in the Policy on Students with Disabilities and Special Needs),
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: whether their condition is permanent or temporary, will be accommodated by means of additional
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: arrangements, which may include the following:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Additional time;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Furnishing question papers in Braille or large print;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Special/separate venues and invigilators;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: (d)  Oral examinations;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Amanuensis examinations; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Special equipment (e.g. computer with screen reading software, where appropriate).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.18.2  Application for disability classification must be submitted to the Directorate for Student Develop-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: ment and Support (SDS) well in advance, which identifies and evaluates students with permanent
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: or temporary disabilities, when they apply for special arrangements.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.18.3  SDS formally notifies the Registrar’s environment of any recommendation one week prior to the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: commencement of the examination, whereupon that section makes the necessary arrangements.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapter 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.18.4  Students with temporary disabilities (injuries, temporary impediments or disorders) report at the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Registrar’s environment, furnishing substantiation of such disability. The Registrar’s environment
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: will refer the student to SDS, for recommendations for reasonable accommodations.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.18.5  The Registrar’s environment scrutinises recommendations, as verified or formulated by SDS, and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: determines what special arrangements must be made.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.18.6  The Registrar’s environment arranges the examination event (venue, invigilator, question paper,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: etc.) and duly informs the student.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.18.7  Where  an  amanuensis  is  used,  or  an  oral  assessment  is  conducted,  the  session  has  to  be  re-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: corded. The recording has to be handed in to the Registrar’s environment with the answer sheet.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The recording could be accessed in case the student queries the marks or irregularities of the oral
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: assessments.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Registration by a student for a module(s) in a specific academic term (semester, year or block) also
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: constitutes registration for examinations, subject to all the applicable rules.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.2.20  When repeating a module, any mark previously obtained for that module shall lapse.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Any student who has been expelled from TUT, and who is not (as a result of such expulsion) allowed
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: on the campus of TUT, shall also not be allowed to write any examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The scheduling of an examination for a block offering module has to be included in the University’s
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination timetable in the year preceding the programme presentation or has to be furnished to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the Registrar’s environment at least four (4) weeks prior to the said examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: WRITING OF EXAMINATIONS AT VENUES EXTERNAL TO THE UNIVERSITY
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Applications to write at a venue external to the university must be submitted by the student at the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Registrar’s environment at least two (2) weeks (10 working days) prior to the examination date of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the relevant module(s), making use of the authorised application form.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: No arrangements will be made by the Registrar’s environment unless:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Proof of payment of the prescribed fee to write elsewhere has been received; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The correctly completed and authorised application form was received by the Registrar’s
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: environment.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Only in exceptional cases will students be accommodated to write examinations elsewhere than
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the campus where they are registered. No requests to write examinations elsewhere for the sake
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of convenience, for instance, closer to home, on holiday, etc., will be considered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Proof of the reason for the request must accompany the application, for example, a statement from
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the employer.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: An official individual examination timetable must accompany the application.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: An  additional  cost  that  may  be  charged  by  another  institution  or  examination  center  will  be  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: student’s responsibility, such as invigilation, courier, telephone and rental of venue costs.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Examination  results  will  be  withheld  if  the  student  does  not  comply  with  the  instructions  on  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: application form to write elsewhere and with the examination rules and regulations of TUT.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Only the main examination can be written at an external venue. It is the student’s responsibility
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to check his/her results in time to determine if he/she qualifies for a supplementary examination
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: and to make the necessary travel, accommodation, etc. arrangements to write the supplementary
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination on the campus where registered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapter 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: TUT shall not assume any responsibility for incorrect information about examination arrangements
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: that has been supplied by means other than the Registrar’s environment.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Although TUT handles the receipt, distribution and safekeeping of all examination documents and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: material carefully and responsibly, the institution does not assume any liability for the loss or de-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: struction of, or damage to such examination documents or material. Should the loss or destruction
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of any examination material prevent the evaluation of the student’s examination performance, TUT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: reserves the right to request the student to undergo a supplementary examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: All parties need to take note of the potential risks involved in this process due to time differences
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: between countries, the courier or mailing services and possible electronic problems.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The dates and times of all examinations written in other countries must correspond with the dates
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: and times of the examinations that are written in South Africa.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: MAIN, SUPPLEMENTARY, SPECIAL AND EXIT EXAMINATIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The following are applicable to examination terminating assessments:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: There are three (3) examination opportunities in an examination cycle, namely main examination,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: supplementary examination and special/exit examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: All examinations must be equivalent in length, standard level and content scope.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: All  examinations  must  be  conducted  at  a  venue  determined  by  TUT,  and  a  student  must  write
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examinations at the venue determined for the campus where he/she is registered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The academic department is responsible for the quality assurance of all marked scripts and the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: authentication of marks before the capturing of marks.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Any student who has been expelled from TUT, and who is not, as a result of such expulsion, allowed
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: on the campus of the University, must also not be allowed to write any examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Any student whose class and/or residence fees have not been paid in full, or who has any other
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: debts at TUT, is allowed to write the examination, but his or her results must not be published until
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the full outstanding amount has been settled. Such students must, however, be informed if they
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: qualify for a supplementary examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.1.7   Any changes to the minimum pass requirements must be approved by Senate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A student will pass a module with distinction by obtaining a final mark of 75% or more in that module.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Minimum pass requirements:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Examination type
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Main Examination
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Minimum pass requirements
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A final pass mark of 50% is required to pass the main examination. A
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: subminimum of 40% for each question paper is required to pass, regardless
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of the predicate mark. If the examination in a module comprises more than
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: one question paper, the student must obtain a subminimum of 40% for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: each of the papers, respectively. The subminimum required for a practical
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination is 50%. The pass mark can be higher than 50% if approved
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: by Senate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Supplementary exami-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: nations
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A final pass mark of 50% is required to pass a supplementary exami-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: nation  and  the  relevant  minimum  rule  applies.  If  the  examination  in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: a module comprises more than one question paper, the student must
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: obtain a subminimum of 40% for each of the papers. The subminimum
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: required for a practical examination is 50%. The pass mark can be high
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: er than 50% if approved by Senate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapter 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Special examinations
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A final pass mark of 50% is required to pass a special examination. No
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: further opportunities will be granted if a student forfeits or fails the spe-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: cial examination. If the examination in a module comprises more than
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: one question paper, the student must obtain a subminimum of 40% for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: each of the papers. The subminimum required for a practical examination
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: is 50%. The pass mark can be higher than 50% if approved by Senate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Exit examinations
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A final pass mark of 50% is required to pass an exit examination. If the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination in a module comprises more than one question paper, the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: student must obtain a subminimum of 40% for each of the papers. The
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: subminimum required for a practical examination is 50%.  The pass mark
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: can be higher than 50% if approved by Senate.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: MAIN EXAMINATION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.2.1   Registration for a module also allows registration for main examination in that specific period, subject
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to all the applicable rules.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.2.2   A  minimum  predicate  mark  of  40%  examination  admission  for  entry  to  the  main  examination  is
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: required, or, if applicable, as published in the module study guide.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.2.3   Any student who fails to attend at least 80% of scheduled contact or online classes and/or fails to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: participate in at least 80% of monitored class activities, will be refused examination admission or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: admission to the summative assessment for the module concerned. (Refer to the Policy on Class
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Attendance and Academic Participation.)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.2.4   A student who fails the main examination in a module, but obtains a final mark of 45% to 49%,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: qualifies for a supplementary examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.2.5   A student with a final mark of 50% or more, but with an examination mark of less than 40% (fail
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: sub-minimum) for theory modules or 50% (fail sub-minimum) for practical modules fail the module
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: and shall qualify for a supplementary examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In  cases  of  modules  consisting  of  two  question  papers,  and  the  student  passed  both  question
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: papers but obtained a final mark of 45% to 49%, the student fails the module and qualifies for a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: supplementary examination in both question papers.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: If a student qualifies for a supplementary examination and the module consists of more than one
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: paper, credit is retained for re-examination purposes for the paper/s that has/have been passed
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: with 50%. The student only has to write a supplementary examination for the paper that was failed.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.2.8   A student who missed the main examination due to exceptional cases may apply to write a special
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: SUPPLEMENTARY EXAMINATION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.3.1   Results  of  students  who  qualify  for  a  supplementary  examination  will  be  published  on  the TUT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: website according to a daily publication schedule.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.3.2   A supplementary examination is scheduled directly after the main examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The predicate mark obtained for admission to the main examination will also apply to the supple-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: mentary examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The final mark for the supplementary examination will be calculated according to the same formula
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: used for the main examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The assessment method of a supplementary examination must be in the same format as the main
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapter 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: It is every student’s responsibility to confirm on the TUT website whether he/she qualifies for a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: supplementary examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Distance Education students write their supplementary examination during the next main examina-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: tion period.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: SPECIAL EXAMINATION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: If a student has a valid reason to miss the supplementary examination, he/she may apply within five
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: (5) working days of the date of the examination, at the Registrar’s environment to write a special
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination. The application must be accompanied by all supporting evidence, as well as proof of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: payment of the prescribed fee for the special examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.4.2   A special examination must be written during the supplementary or exit/special examination period
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of a specific examination cycle.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The predicate mark obtained for admission to the main examination will also apply to the special
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: If a student has a valid reason to be absent from the main examination and first special examination
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: opportunity, as a result of extended illness, extenuating circumstances, or due to the late publication
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of marks, he/she may apply to write during the second special examination opportunity. This will be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the student’s final opportunity during the specific examination cycle.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In the case of illness, the application for a special examination will only be approved on submission
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: of original medical certificates issued by a medical practitioner or registered traditional healer. The
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: certificate must indicate the duration of illness that must be inclusive of examination dates.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In the case of extenuating circumstances, an application for special examination may be submit-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: ted in writing at the Registrar’s environment before the closing date as published in the academic
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: core calendar of the University.  The application must be accompanied by all original supporting
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: evidence, as well as proof of the payment of the prescribed fee for the special examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: If a student is unable to write one or more question papers in a module consisting of more than one
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: question paper, he/she will only be granted a special examination in the question paper(s) that he/
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: she was unable to write. The student will retain the marks for the question paper(s) that was/were
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: written.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.4.8     A student may, notwithstanding the above-mentioned provisions, submit a written appeal to the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Registrar’s environment for consideration, after the application fee has been paid, if that student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: is of the opinion that his/her case has merit and should be taken into consideration. This appeal
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: must be submitted to the Registrar’s environment within five (5) working days of the date of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination the student had been unable to write on account of the specific circumstances.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The final mark for the special examination will be calculated according to the same formula used
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: for the main examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.4.10   The assessment method of a special examination must be the same format as the main examina-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: tion.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.4.11   A student has to register for the module again if he/she fails the special examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: EXIT EXAMINATION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.5.1   Prior to the application for an exit examination, a student’s registration for the qualification must not
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: have been interrupted (excluding modules that are only offered every second year).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The student must have been registered for the module and obtained a predicate mark during the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: period of registration. The necessary minimum admission requirements to the main examination
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: shall also apply to the exit examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapter 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The final mark for the exit examination will be calculated according to the same formula used for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the main examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The student must take the examination on the campus where he/she has been registered for the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: module concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.5.5   All students who remained with one theoretical module to qualify for their respective qualifications
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: in a particular study period - excluding students who remained with a non-examination terminating
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: module, will be allowed to apply for exit examinations.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In cases where a qualification will not be issued due to Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) ad-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: mission requirements, or non-degree registration, applications for an exit examination will not be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: considered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.4.5.7   A  student  who,  for  any  reason  whatsoever,  does  not  write  an  exit  examination,  or  fails  the  exit
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: examination,  will  fail  the  module(s)  concerned,  and  no  further  examination  opportunity  shall  be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: granted. The student must register for the module again and obtain a new predicate mark.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The assessment method of an exit examination must be in the same format as the main examina-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: tion.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The student must apply to write an exit examination to the Registrar’s environment before the clo-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: sing date published in the academic core calendar of TUT.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In the event that a student qualifies for an exit examination after a special examination period due
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to late publication of main examination results, he/she will only get a final opportunity in the next
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: exit examination period.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In the event that a student was absent or failed the main/supplementary/special examination, he/
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: she will qualify to write an exit examination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In the event that a module is only offered every second-year registration period, and this is the only
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: outstanding module to qualify after the next registration period, the student will have the opportunity
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to apply for an exit examination in the year that the module is not offered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: PROCESSING AND PUBLICATION OF PREDICATE AND FINAL RESULTS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: PREDICATE MARKS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.5.1.1  On re-registration for a module, any predicate mark or practical mark previously obtained for that
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: module must lapse, unless clearly specified in a different way in the Prospectus and the study guide.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The academic departments are required to enter assessment results as required on the ITS system,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: before the next assessment, and not exceeding 21 days after each assessment, according to the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: published pre-determined weights for different assessments.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.5.1.3   Students are responsible for checking their marks after each assessment during the semester/year
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: on the student portal or at the relevant academic department.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.5.1.4   Predicate marks must be published on the official Predicate Day, at least five (5) working days before
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the classes officially end, as published in the University's Prospectus (Part 1) and Academic Core
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Calendar.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.5.1.5   Students are allowed five (5) working days after the official publication of the predicate marks to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: appeal to the HoD or the lecturer concerned, if they are of the opinion that their published marks
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: are incorrect. The HoD or relevant lecturer will adjust and compute the marks on the ITS system
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: within the five-day period and issue the student with proof of the changes.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Chapter 4
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A predicate mark of at least 40% is required for admission to the final examination. The predicate
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: mark will contribute 50% to the final mark and the examination will contribute 50% to the final mark.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A predicate mark of 39% will not be automatically adjusted on the ITS system. No changes will be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: accommodated after predicate week.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: PROCESSING AND PUBLICATION OF FINAL RESULTS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The Registrar’s environment must process and publish the final results on the date as pu-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: blished in the Academic Core Calendar.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: (b)  Results must be made available and will only be official if published through an approved
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: format, for example, TUT website; TUT learning management system; and personal academic
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: results.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: (c)  Results of the candidates that qualify for supplementary examinations must be published by
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: the Registrar’s environment according to a publication schedule.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: In the case of block examinations, results of students who qualify for supplementary examina-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: tions must be made available electronically according to the dates provided by the depart-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: ment.  Final results will be available after the supplementary examination, on the date provided
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: by the department.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Any enquiries with regards to the outcome of results will only be handled when the student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: can present his/her student card or any other form of official identification.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: No automatic adjustment of final marks will be conducted by the ITS system (e.g. 49% to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: RESULTS ENQUIRIES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Examination result enquiries must be submitted on the prescribed form to the Registrar’s environment
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: before the closing date for enquiries as indicated in the Academic Core Calendar of the University
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: or in Part 1 of the Prospectus’ important dates. A penalty fee, according to the approved tariff list,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: is payable for enquiries received after the closing date.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: VIEWING OF ANSWERING SCRIPTS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.5.4.1   Applications for viewing of examination answer scripts must be submitted on the prescribed form
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: to the Registrar’s environment before the closing date for enquiries as indicated in the Academic
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: Core Calendar of the University or in Part 1 of the Prospectus’ important dates.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: The applicant must pay the prescribed fee according to the approved tariff list to receive an op-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: portunity to view his or her examination scripts for all theoretical examinations at all levels of all
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: modules.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.5.4.3   Obvious mistakes will be reported by the student and will be attended to, and if required, the student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: can apply for re-marking of the script and pay the prescribed fee according to the approved tariff
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: list.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: 4.5.4.4   Memoranda must be made available to students during the viewing of scripts process.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: RE-MARKING OF ANSWERING SCRIPTS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: A student may, subject to the payment of the prescribed fee according to the approved tariff list,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: have his or her examination scripts for all theoretical examinations re-marked by the moderator at
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: all levels of all modules. In the event where a student requests a re-mark and the script has been
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: moderated already, the moderator must not conduct the re-mark. The HoD must assign the task to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: another qualified appointed person.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 3"]

text: An application for re-marking an examination script is required to reach the Registrar’s environment
