text: RULES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Please refer to Chapter 30 for the applicable rules.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: APPROVAL AND REGISTRATION OF A PROJECT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Please note that the relevant instructions and procedures are contained in the publication Students’
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: guidelines for postgraduate study, which is available on request.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: For postgraduate degrees, prospective students must first apply for admission to TUT Admissions
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Office, and then do the abstract (pre-registration evaluation) to get clearance to register.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: After the Departmental Research Committee and Innovation (DRCI) has accepted a provisional
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: project, the student may register, keeping in mind the provisions of rule 8.2.1.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Registered students who have not yet passed a research methodology module/subject will have
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: to complete it, in consultation with the Head of the Department.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: After clearance to register, the student must submit the full research proposal to the Departmental
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Research Committee within reasonable time. The student and the supervisor will be required to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: submit a progress report every six months.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: DISSERTATION OR THESIS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: After assessment, the student must make the corrections as required by the supervisor and then
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: prepare one (1) electronic copy. The copy, accompanied by the declaration of completion of stud-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: ies, and a draft scholarly article for publication in a peer-reviewed journal (master’s) or copies of at
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: least two (2) scholarly articles that have already been submitted for publication in a peer-reviewed
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: journal  (doctorate)  must  be  handed  in  to  the  DRC  for  submission  to  the  Faculty  Committee  for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Postgraduate Studies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: When the student has progressed with the project to the satisfaction of his or her supervisor, the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: soft-bound copy of the thesis or dissertation must be prepared. The dissertation or thesis must be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: typed, and the layout must be the final version, which must comply with the set guidelines.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: The editing and the technical standard of the dissertation are the responsibility of the student and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: must comply with the norms contained in the publication Guidelines for the preparation of disserta-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: tions and theses.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: 31 March for the Spring graduation ceremonies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: 31 October for the Autumn graduation ceremonies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Closing dates:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: These copies must be handed in before one of the following dates in order for the qualification to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: be conferred at the next graduation ceremony:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Before 31 July for the Spring graduation ceremonies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Before 28 February for the Autumn graduation ceremonies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Chapter 8
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: PASS REQUIREMENTS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: A student will pass a module/subject that has been set for a postgraduate programme, such as
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Bachelor of Honours, Postgraduate Diploma and Structured Master's degree by obtaining a pass
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: mark, or a final mark of 50% or more for that module/subject, subject to the provisions of the rules
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: in Chapter 4 and by obtaining a final mark of 50% or more for a module/subject with its own alpha-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: numerical code, subject to the provisions that he or she obtains the required subminimum of 40%
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: in the assessment, or according to faculty specifications for the structured master's degrees.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: A student will pass a module/subject with distinction by obtaining a final mark of at least 75% in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: that module/subject. This implies that each separate module should also have been passed with a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: mark of at least 75% (refer to Chapter 4).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Students must obtain a pass mark in a research report, dissertation or thesis.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: The format of a dissertation or thesis must be according to the guidelines, the language must be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: edited, and it must be compiled and produced in accordance with the guidelines contained in the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: publication Guidelines for the preparation of dissertations and theses.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: REQUIREMENTS FOR GRADUATION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Research-based master's degrees
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: In order to be awarded a research-based master’s degree, a student has to comply with the follo-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: wing requirements:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: At  least  one  (1)  scholarly  article,  should  already  have  been  submitted  for  publication  to  a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: DHET-accredited journal, with written proof that the accredited journal has received the article
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: (to be handed in with the final dissertation).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: A dissertation to be assessed and passed by two (2) external assessors.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Structured master's degrees
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: In order for a student to pass the mini-dissertation, it has to be examined and passed by two (2)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: external assessors.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Doctorates
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: In order to be awarded a doctorate, a student has to comply with the following requirements:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Copies of at least two (2) scholarly articles that have already been submitted for publication
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: in an accredited or peer-reviewed journal (proof that the articles have been received must be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: handed in with the copies of the final version or legal deposit copy of the thesis).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: A thesis to be assessed and passed by two (2) external assessors.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: A successful defence of the thesis.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Please note that faculties may add their own requirements, as approved by the Senate. All require-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: ments must be clearly stated in the Prospectus of each faculty.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: CESSION OF COPYRIGHT AND PUBLICATION OF DISSERTATION OR THESIS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: The copyright on a dissertation or thesis that is submitted to TUT in fulfilment or partial fulfilment
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: of the requirements for a master’s degree or doctorate shall vest in the University, irrespective of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: whether such dissertation or thesis is accepted or not.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: (a)  The copyright should therefore be ceded. On registration, it is pointed out to the student that,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: on signing the form (PGS010), the entire copyright is ceded to TUT, unless if, in exceptional
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: circumstances, exemption from cession of copyright is applied for and granted. Fully substan-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: tiated reasons must be submitted with applications for exemption.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: If a dissertation or thesis is not accepted, the student may apply to the University for the ceding
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: of copyright back to him or her.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Chapter 8
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: (b)  No dissertation or thesis or any part thereof, including any summary of the dissertation or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: any part thereof, shall be printed or published without the permission of the Registrar. Such
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: permission may be granted, subject to –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: reference being made in the published work to it having been submitted to TUT in the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: form of a dissertation or thesis;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: one or more copies of the published work being handed in at the University; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: such changes being effected as may be recommended by the supervisor, examiners or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: others, and such other conditions being met as the University may deem fit from time
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: to time.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: If permission is granted to a student to publish his or her dissertation or thesis, the publication of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: the work must be carried out in consultation with his or her supervisor.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: RIGHT TO APPEAL
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: Postgraduate candidates who are not satisfied with the outcome of the final marks for their research
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: reports, dissertations or theses may submit written appeals to the Executive Dean of the Faculty
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: The Executive Dean of the Faculty and the relevant Head of the Department will decide on the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: merit of an additional assessment option. Where an additional assessment is introduced, no further
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: assessments will be conducted after the calculation of a new fixed mark.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 8"]

text: CHAPTER 9
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: ISSUING OF CERTIFICATES, DIPLOMAS AND DEGREES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: A certificate, diploma or degree will be issued to a student who meets the requirements for obtaining
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: such a qualification. A qualification means a formal recognition and certification of learning achieve-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: ments awarded by an accredited provider. It also signifies and formally certifies the demonstrated
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: achievement  by  a  student  of  a  planned  and  purposeful  combination  of  learning  outcomes  at  a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: specified level of performance.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: Certificates, diplomas and degrees will only be conferred on the dates of the University’s official
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: graduation ceremonies. Candidates who cannot attend these graduation ceremonies may collect
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: their certificates with proof of identification, and if all the fees are paid after the date of the ceremony.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: Original qualification certificates will not be reissued to students in cases where the original docu-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: ments have been lost, damaged or destroyed. Only a duplicate qualification statement will be issued.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: Qualifications are conferred cum laude in the following cases:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: To obtain a qualification cum laude, the average mark for all modules/subjects, including exit-level
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: modules/subjects,  or  the  final  mark  for  dissertation  or  mini-dissertation,  must  add  up  to  75%.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: If a student passes all the set modules/subjects in the first examination. A student may not fail
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: an examination in any modules/subjects at any level in the programme of his or her studies in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: respect of a qualification. An aegrotat or special examination is also seen as a first examination
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: if it is the student’s first attempt to pass the modules/subjects.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: (ii)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: If a student passes a qualification with the option of modules/subjects with an average of at
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: least 75% for all required modules/subjects, as well as an average of at least 75% for the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: required modules/subjects at exit level.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: (iii)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: If,  in respect of a qualification with the option of a dissertation, such as a magister technologiae,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: master's degree or a master's degree (Professional) a student obtains a final mark of at least
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: 75% for the dissertation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: Chapters 8 & 9
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: (iv)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: If, in respect of an option with modules/subjects and a mini-dissertation, such as a magister
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: technologiae, master's degree or a master's degree (Professional) a student obtains an ave-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: rage mark of at least 75% for all the required modules/subjects, as well as a final mark of at
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: least 75% for the mini-dissertation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: A doctor technologiae, doctoral degree or a doctoral degree (Professional)  is not awarded with
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: distinction. A student’s results are published as “pass” or “fail”.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: A certificate, diploma, degree, examination result or academic report issued erroneously by the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: University is not valid and must be returned to the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: Any  person  who  forges  a  certificate,  diploma,  degree  or  statement  issued  by  the  University,  or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: submits any forged documents to the University, is guilty of misconduct.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: Only the Registrar may issue a letter confirming that a student meets all the requirements of a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: certificate, diploma or degree.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: A candidate will be entitled to all the privileges associated with the qualification only after it has
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: been officially awarded at a graduation ceremony of the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: A qualification certificate will be issued only in the name(s) and surname of the student as indicated
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: on the admission documentation pertaining to the qualification awarded.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: A candidate who has complied with the academic requirements for the issuing of a qualification and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: has outstanding fees will be invited to the graduation ceremony, but -
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: the certificate will be withheld;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: the academic record will be blocked by the Certification Management Office; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: no qualification verification will be done for external stakeholders.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: CLOSING DATES FOR GRADUATION CEREMONIES:

text: Closing date for Autumn graduation ceremonies: 28 February.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: Closing date for Spring graduation ceremonies: 31 August.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: A candidate who has complied with the academic requirements for the issuing of a qualification before
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: the teach-out (phase-out) date but failed to graduate due to outstanding admission documents or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: any unforeseen circumstances shall submit an application for the issuing of such a qualification to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: the Certification Management Office. The application shall be forwarded to the relevant faculty for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: consideration and referred to Senate for approval.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: A phased-out qualification can still be issued on condition that the programme is still accredited and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: actively registered on the NQF by SAQA. It remains the responsibility of the student to familiarise
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: him- or herself with the phased out-dates of the qualification as well as NQF registration as supplied
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: by TUT.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: A candidate who failed to comply with the academic requirements for the issuing of a qualification
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: before the teach-out (phase-out) date due to poor academic performance or interruption of studies
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: will forfeit the right to complete his or her studies in terms of the rules of the  teach-out (phase-out)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: qualification. The student will be transferred over to the reviewed programme on condition he or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: she complies with all the admission requirements of the reviewed programme. The student also
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 9"]

text: has to apply for exemption of the applicable modules/subjects' credits.

text: CONTAGIOUS DISEASES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: In terms of section 45 of the Health Act, 1977 (Act No. 63 of 1977), the medical conditions below
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: are notifiable. The Tshwane University of Technology (TUT) must therefore be informed in writing
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: of such medical conditions without delay.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: Anthrax

text: fever, Rift Valley fever)

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: Rabies (specify whether human case or human contact)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: Rubella
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: Smallpox and any smallpox-like disease, excluding chickenpox
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: Tetanus
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: (i)  Pulmonary and other forms, except cases diagnosed solely on the basis of clinical signs
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: and symptoms.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: (ii)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: In the case of any child younger than five (5) years with a significant reaction following
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: Chapters 10 & 11
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: If a student suspects that he or she has a contagious or an infectious disease that may be transmit-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: ted to other people, and should he or she participate in any TUT activities, for example (without any
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: limitations), accommodation in TUT residences, sitting for examinations or tests, or participation in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: TUT projects, sport or recreational activities, he or she must obtain medical advice and/or undergo
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: the required treatment without delay.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: Should such medical advice entail that the student has to withdraw from any or all TUT activities,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: he or she must act accordingly.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: Should such a student fail to withdraw from the activity or activities in question, he or she must exempt
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: TUT from any liability of any kind whatsoever, whether directly or indirectly, for the consequences
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: of his or her failing to do so.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: Should a student have suffered from a contagious or an infectious disease, or have been in contact
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: with any person suffering from such disease, the student must submit a medical certificate to the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: Registrar, containing confirmation that the student may return to TUT without there being any danger
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: of him or her infecting other students.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 11"]

text: CHAPTER 12
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: ATTENDANCE OF LECTURES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: RULES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: All TUT students are expected to attend and participate in contact and online classes, complete the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: assigned reading and writing assignments, complete assigned projects and practicals, and write all
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: required assessments.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: Regular class attendance and participation is the responsibility of each student, and it is expected that
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: all TUT students shall attend and participate in classes for all their registered modules. Any student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: who fails to attend at least 80% of scheduled contact or online classes and/or fails to participate in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: at least 80% of monitored class activities, will be refused examination admission or admission to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: the summative assessment for the module concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: A student who (for whatever reason) cannot attend and participate in at least 80% of scheduled
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: contact or online classes or activities of a particular module may apply to the academic Head of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: Department or Section Head for exemption. Such applications should be submitted prior to the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: closing date of registration so that a student can deregister a module, should exemption not be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: granted.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: 12.1.4  While the lecturers should seek, to the greatest extent possible, to make class attendance and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: participation requirements known to students, it is the responsibility of each student to be aware of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: and comply with the class attendance and participation requirements for each and every module
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: he or she is registered for.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: If there is proof of non-compliance with the class attendance and participation requirements, the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: Tshwane University of Technology reserves the right to refuse such a student examination admission
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: or admission to summative assessments. If a student failed to get admission to the examination or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: the summative assessment as a result of non- compliance with the class attendance requirements,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: such student shall still be liable for full class fees.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: Any absence, excused or unexcused, prevents students from getting the full benefit of the module
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: and meeting the notional hours required to obtain module credits. To obtain the number of notional
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: hours, the HEQSF-aligned module credits are multiplied by a factor of 10, i.e. 10 credits require at
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: least 100 notional hours.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: Chapter 11 & 12
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: An absence, with or without an excuse, does not relieve a student of any module requirements. An
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: excused absence is limited to absence related to medical conditions, family emergencies (such as
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: funerals) and official university activities.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: An excused absence related to medical conditions and family emergencies (such as funerals) must
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: be supported by documentation to be presented to the lecturer prior to the student's absence or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: within two (2) working days upon the student's return to class. Appropriate supporting documenta-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: tion should be provided for family emergencies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: In the case of official University activities, the apology must be submitted with the supporting docu-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: mentation prior to the event.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: In the event of illness or injury resulting in absence of more than two (2) consecutive days or class
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: sessions, a medical certificate will be required. However, TUT reserves the right to demand a medi-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: cal certificate at any time.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: In all instances, it is the student's responsibility to request permission for absence from contact
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: or online classes and to discuss how the absence will affect his or her ability to meet the module
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: requirements. While the lecturers should seek, to the greatest extent possible, to be consistent with
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: module requirements, to make reasonable accommodation for absence with acceptable excuse,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: students should recognise that not every module can accommodate absences, and neither will the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: absence relieve them from meeting module requirements.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: If a student fails to comply with the class attendance and/or participation requirements, he or she
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: will not qualify to write the exam or summative assessment regardless of the marks achieved in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: the module. A student who is of the opinion that the penalty received following violation of class
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: attendance or participation requirements is not appropriate may, after consultation with the lecturer,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: appeal in writing to the academic Head of Department or Section Head at least three (3) days before
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: the writing of the exam or summative assessment, and finally, to the Dean.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: To be fair to all students, monitoring of class attendance and participation will commence upon the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: closing date of registration, but it does not mean that class attendance and participation prior to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: the registration date is not important.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: PRESCRIBED BOOKS

["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: At the beginning of each academic semester or year, the lecturers concerned will provide all regi-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: stered students with a list of set (prescribed) books.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: All students are expected to obtain the relevant set books.

text: Study material is sent to all distance education students upon registration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 12"]

text: CHAPTER 14
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: PRESCRIBED WORK AND CLASS TESTS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: Students must do all set (prescribed) work and write all class tests.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: Students who register after classes have commenced may not claim any concession regarding
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: lectures presented, tests written, etc. before they had registered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: A student must attend and participate in classes according to his or her registration, for example,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: according to campus, qualification, module/subject, block, semester.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: Chapters 12, 13 & 14
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: (a)  Students must regularly attend all lectures, group lectures, seminars, practical sessions and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: excursions that form part of their set study programme. The requirements of the Department
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: of Higher Education and Training (DHET) in this regard must be complied with.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: Individual faculties may include percentages in terms of attendance of lectures, if required.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: Individual faculties may set their own requirements for the attendance of lectures.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: If there is proof of non-compliance with rule 14.4(a), TUT reserves the right to cancel a stu-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: dent’s registration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: In the event of illness or injury resulting in absence of more than two (2) consecutive days, a medical
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: certificate must be submitted. However, TUT reserves the right to demand a medical certificate at
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: any time.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: required by the Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 14"]

text: CHAPTER 15
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: STUDENT DISCIPLINE
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Please note:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Any student who contravenes the provisions of rule 15.1 of the disciplinary code is guilty of misconduct and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: will be dealt with in terms of the disciplinary code for students. For the purposes of this disciplinary code, the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: word “University” refers to the Tshwane University of Technology (TUT).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: MISCONDUCT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: The following actions, omissions and conduct by a student are regarded as misconduct:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Any statutory or common law offence or any attempt to commit such an offence or instigating
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: another person to commit such an offence.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Conviction of any criminal offence during his or her period of study at the University, irrespective of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: the place where such offence took place.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Intentionally or negligently contravening or subverting, or attempting to contravene or subvert, or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: assisting, encouraging or persuading any other person to contravene or subvert a code, regulation,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: rule or instruction of the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Refusal to obey any fair or reasonable instruction or request of any statutory body, lecturer, member
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: of the Students’ Representative Council (SRC), any official or any person acting on behalf of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: University, or any violation of such instruction or request within the framework of any rule, regulation
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: or law applicable to the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Damaging, defacing, destruction, theft, being in possession of stolen property, housebreaking and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: theft,  appropriation  or  alienation  of  University  property  or  property  controlled  by  the  University,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: including that of another student, employee, visitor or person associated with the University, or any
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: attempt to do so.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Using University property or any property controlled by the University or property of another student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: or a staff member without permission.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Bringing onto, or possession, using, selling or distribution of any alcoholic beverages and/or illicit
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: drugs on University premises or premises controlled by the University or during any official excur-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: sion or tour without the permission of the Vice-Chancellor or any person delegated by him or her.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Being under the influence of alcoholic beverages or drugs while participating in the activities of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: University or where the student may be identified with the activities of the University or any abuse
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: of alcoholic beverages or drugs on University premises or  premises controlled by the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Chapters 14 & 15

["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Improper, disgraceful or indecent behaviour on any premises of the University or premises controlled
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: by the University or at any other place where the student’s behaviour is identifiable with or can
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: possibly be identified with the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.10  Any abusive, swearing or indecent act towards any employee, student or person associated with
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: the University that is a violation of his or her dignity or body, either on the premises of the University
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: or elsewhere.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.11  Engaging in behaviour that may bring the image of the University into disrepute or any act that may
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: be detrimental to or jeopardise the maintenance of discipline or which is detrimental to providing
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: normal services, efficient tuition and the conducting of research.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.12  Using violence against, or threatening or intimidating any person on any premises of the University
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: or premises controlled by the University, or during participation in any University activity, or anywhere
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: else where the student may be identified with the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.13  Bringing onto the University premises, or possessing, pointing or handling a firearm or any other
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: dangerous weapon, explosive or fuel without the necessary permission or the pretence that such
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: weapon, explosive or fuel will be used on any premises of the University, or pointing a firearm at
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: any person.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.14  Helping or trying to help another student during a class test, examination or any form of assessment,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: or obtaining or trying to obtain help from another student during such test, examination or assess-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: ment, or the submission of any test, examination script or written assignment or any assessment
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: of another student in his or her name.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.15  Being  in  possession  of  any  form  of  unauthorised  notes,  using  or  trying  to  use  notes  that  have
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: relevance, or any kind of resource during any test or examination, except where the supervisor or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: lecturer concerned has consented explicitly to such possession and/or use, or refusal to hand over
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: such notes to the invigilator, or destroying or trying to destroy such notes in any way, or making
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: notes during a test or examination on any object, ruler or pocket calculator, except as laid down
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: and permitted.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.16  Handing in any written assignment for assessment in which the essential parts of the assignment
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: have been copied from the work of another person, or any form of plagiarism.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.17  Reproduction or transmission in any form or manner, whether electronically or mechanically (including
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: photocopying, recording or using any other form of information storage or retrieval), of any study
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: guide, book, thesis, dissertation, article, examination paper, lecture, printed tutorial matter or any
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: other study aids in respect of which copyright exists, unless such reproduction or transmission is
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: done in a manner authorised in terms of the Copyright Act, 1978 (Act No. 98 of 1978), and unless
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: the copyright owner‛s permission for the reproduction or transmission is obtained.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.18  Making a deliberately false statement or furnishing false information to any University employee,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: official body, committee, any person associated with the University, Students’ Representative Coun-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: cil or any student who is a student leader.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Furnishing false or erroneous information about the University to any person or body.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Forging any certificate, degree, diploma, document or statement of the University, or submitting
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: any forged document to the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.21  Any fraud committed on any premises of the University, or premises controlled by or associated
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: with the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: control of the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: student or any person to use such a student card or access card to perform any action or obtain
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: any benefit or service that can be performed or obtained with such a card.

text: Chapter 15
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.1.24  Committing any act or form of harassment, sexual assault, racism, unfair discrimination or violation
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: of the dignity or body of any employee, student or person associated with the University, or any
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: students or destabilise the functioning of the University.

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: the University premises without the official approval of the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: contravene any of the rules of the University.

text: REPORTING OF ALLEGED MISCONDUCT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: A charge of alleged misconduct should be laid in writing with the Head of Student Judicial Services
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: within seven (7) days, or such period that is reasonable under the circumstances, of the date of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: the alleged misconduct, or within such period that is reasonable under the circumstances, of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: date on which the alleged misconduct came to or should reasonably have come to the knowledge
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: of the complainant.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: The Head of Student Judicial Services or his or her proxy acts as the prosecutor.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (a)  The prosecutor, with the assistance of the University’s investigating officers, investigates the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: charge of alleged misconduct where necessary and formulates the charge disclosed by the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: evidence in the course of such investigation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: If the investigation is completed and the prosecutor is of the opinion that a case cannot be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: made, he or she may decline to proceed.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (c)  Proceedings may be postponed for a period of two (2) days or, in exceptional cases, for such
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: a period as the committee may deem reasonable –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: if the student concerned asks for an opportunity to answer or prepare for an amended
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: charge;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: if the student concerned is absent due to illness;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: if, in the opinion of the chairperson, the student concerned was not given sufficient time
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: to prepare for the hearing;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: in order to formulate a suitable finding; or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: by a mutual agreement between the chairperson and the student concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (d)  The prosecutor may submit any documentary evidence at a hearing and call witnesses to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: substantiate the charge. A committee may admit a written statement of a witness, subject to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: the right of the accused student to dispute the content of such a statement.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (e)  The  student  concerned  or  any  witnesses  called  by  him  or  her  may  be  questioned  by  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: prosecutor and members of the committees contemplated in rules 15.2.2, 15.2.3 and 15.2.4.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (f)  A student who is charged with misconduct may personally or through his or her representative –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: address a committee at the start of the proceedings to explain the basis of his or her
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: defence;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: question any or all of the witnesses called by the prosecutor;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: Chapter 15
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: inspect any document or exhibit submitted as evidence at his or her hearing;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: submit evidence him- or herself in support of his or her defence or in mitigation of sentence;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: call witnesses in support of his or her defence or in mitigation of sentence; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: address a committee in defence or in mitigation of sentence after all the evidence has
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: been submitted.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (g)  The committee must deliberate after the hearing and decide whether the accused student is
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: guilty or not.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: If the committee cannot reach a unanimous decision, a majority decision becomes the decision
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: of the committee.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: The chairperson has the right to make a ruling in all matters relating to the procedures of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: hearing.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: In the event of an equality of votes, the chairperson has a casting vote.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (k)  The chairperson informs the student concerned orally of the committee’s decision, and also
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: confirms it immediately in writing.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.11.2  Subject to the provisions of rule 15.3.5, the decisions of the Academic Disciplinary Committee and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: the Student Affairs Disciplinary Committee are final.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.11.3  Previous convictions of misconduct may be taken into consideration by a disciplinary committee in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: deciding on appropriate disciplinary measures.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.11.4  Notwithstanding the provisions of rule 15.11.1(a), the head of the campus in rule 15.6 designates
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: an employee to act as the secretary.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.11.5  An accused student may be represented at the hearing by a fellow student or University employee.

["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: The disciplinary hearing is conducted in camera. However, the chairperson may, in his or her discre-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: tion, allow any person who has an interest in the hearing to attend as an observer.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: proceedings:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (a)  Members of the disciplinary committee.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (b)  The accused student.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (c)  The representative of the accused student.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (d)  The secretary of the disciplinary committee.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: (e)  An interpreter.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: evidence.

["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: If the behaviour of the accused student, a witness or any other person makes it impossible to conduct
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.13.10  be notified of the disciplinary measures imposed;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.13.11  appeal to the appropriate higher authority at the University in writing within seven (7) workdays after
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: the hearing; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]

text: 15.13.12  present evidence in mitigation of sentence.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 15"]
