text: of injuries and/or death, the South African Police Service and the local traffic department must be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: notified.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: In cases where only the vehicle has been damaged, the accident should be reported to the nearest
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: police station within 24 hours. A case reference number must always be obtained from the police.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: The Head of the Transport Department must also be informed immediately.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: If it is suspected that the driver of the other vehicle is under the influence of alcohol or drugs, every
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: effort should be made to bring this to the attention of the South African Police Service or the traffic
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: officer at the scene.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: At the scene of the accident, the following particulars of each of the vehicles involved in the accident
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: must be obtained:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Registration number.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Make and type of vehicle.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Name and contact numbers of driver and owner of the other vehicle.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Name of insurance company.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Name and address of eyewitnesses (if any).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Dimensions of the vehicle and its position at the scene of the accident.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Chapter 21
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: The driver must complete the internal accident form on the next working day and submit it to the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Head of the Transport Department.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: GENERAL RULES AND PROCEDURES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.10.1  Vehicles may only be driven by drivers who signed for them. Control of the vehicle may be handed
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: over to a fellow licensed official only in exceptional circumstances, such as the following:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (a)  When the driver becomes ill.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (b)  When circumstances dictate that the driver should stay behind while the other official has to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: return to the campus concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (c)  When a driver is considered to be under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (d)  All the above should be done with the full knowledge of the Head of the Transport Department.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: The shortest route possible must be taken between the campus and the final destination.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.10.3  All reasonable precautions must be taken to protect the vehicle and its contents against theft, fire
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: and illicit use.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.10.4  No non-official passengers may be transported.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.10.5  No private vehicle may be pushed or towed with an official vehicle.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Traffic fines are payable by the driver, unless a defect in the vehicle was the cause of the infringe-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: ment of the regulation in question at the time.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.10.6.1   In the case where the driver is a student, the fine must be paid immediately and if not paid, the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: student’s academic results shall be withheld, certificates shall not be issued and/or subsequent
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: registration shall be prevented if any traffic fine is outstanding.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.10.6.2   The deduction of the unpaid infringement fine for students will be aligned with the policy on Student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Accounts.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.10.6.3   Drivers must adhere to all traffic regulations, as well as personally settling any fines arising from
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: the infringement of traffic regulations.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: If a vehicle is handed back in an exceptionally dirty condition, the cost of having it cleaned by an
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: outside firm will be charged to the account of the entity concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: If it is found that a driver drove negligently or recklessly, the licence of that driver at the Transport
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Department will be cancelled, and no vehicle will be issued to him or her again.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (a)  Only registered students of TUT who have been in possession of valid driver’s licences for a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: period of at least two (2) years will be allowed to drive a vehicle of the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (b)  A professional driver’s permit (PDP) is a prerequisite in cases where a bigger vehicle, such
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: as a minibus carrying more than twelve (12) persons, is issued.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (c)  All student drivers’ driving skills will be tested by the Head of the Transport Department and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: the Transport Officer concerned, should circumstances allow or require it.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.10.9  No TUT buses or vehicles shall be made available for funerals of the deceased staff members.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: Chapter 21
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: DISCIPLINARY MEASURES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: If  a  vehicle  has  been  damaged  in  any  way  whatsoever,  and  the  damage  may  be  attributed  to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: negligence on the part of the driver and/or user(s) concerned –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (a)  disciplinary steps will be taken against the driver and/or user(s);
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: the excess payment in respect of the insurance, namely 20% of the claim, will be recovered
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: from the driver and/or user; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (c)  no vehicle will be issued to the person(s) concerned again.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.11.2  A fine of R100 per hour for every full hour may be imposed on the entity concerned if a vehicle was
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: not returned at the scheduled time, and the Transport Department had not been informed of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: delay in advance.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: It remains the responsibility of the relevant line manager of the user department concerned to ensure
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: that the 20% excess is paid within thirty (30) days of the day of the accident (see rule 21.11.1(b)).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: STUDENT BUS TRANSPORT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.12.1  All non-residence students (Day students) must complete an application form online.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: 21.12.2  Once a student is registered for the bus transport levy, cancellation will only be accepted on the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: following conditions:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (a)  Student de-registered from the university; or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: (b)   Student placed in any accredited/TUT Residence.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 21"]

text: CHAPTER 22
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 22"]

text: GUEST SPEAKERS ON CAMPUS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 22"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 22"]

text: Any student association or body that wishes to invite persons from outside the Tshwane University
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 22"]

text: of Technology (TUT) to act as guest speakers on any of its campuses must inform the Student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 22"]

text: Representative Council (SRC) of its intention before extending the invitation. The SRC must then
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 22"]

text: immediately get in touch with the Executive Director of Student Affairs and Residence Operations,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 22"]

text: or the Campus Director in the case of a distance campus, to obtain the required permission.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 22"]

text: CHAPTER 23
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: VENUE OR FACILITY BOOKING AND PERMISSION FOR THE USE OF
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: CONDITIONS FOR ALL CAMPUSES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: The application, official booking form and event approval form must be completed and signed by
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: the  persons  indicated  and,  accompanied  by  the  total  amount  payable,  submitted  to  the  Facility
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Manager at fourteen (14) workdays before the relevant function is due to take place.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Cancellations must be made in writing to the Facility Manager at least seven (7) workdays before
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: the date on which the function is due to take place. If a cancellation is made earlier than seven (7)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: workdays before the function is due to take place, the deposit is repayable; if it is made later than
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: seven (7) workdays before the function is due to take place, the deposit is forfeited.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Chapters 21, 22 & 23
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Permission will be granted to student organisations that wish to use halls, rooms, areas or facilities
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: only if they have been duly registered at Student Governance and Leadership Development. If such
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: an organisation has not been duly registered, it has to comply with the same conditions of contract,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: tariffs and booking requirements as outside organisations.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: The official guardian of the student organisation whose application has been approved will be co-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: responsible for compliance with the provisions as stipulated in the booking form regarding student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: activities.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: The right of admission is reserved.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Persons who attend the function must behave in a disciplined and well-ordered manner throughout.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Where any form of destructive and/or inappropriate behaviour occurs, the responsible person must
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: request offenders to leave the premises immediately. In serious cases of misconduct, he or she
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: should contact Campus Protection Services to take control of the situation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Only security officers of Campus Protection Services may be employed. Special security and/or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: traffic arrangements may be made in advance with the Head of Campus Protection Services.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: A report must be drawn up of any damage caused and/or any cases of serious misconduct at the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: function  and  must  be  submitted  within  24  hours  of  the  function  to  the  person  who  has  granted
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: permission for the function to be held. A copy of such a report must be sent to the Head of Campus
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Protection Services.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Only someone who has been duly authorised thereto may sign the booking form(s) for approval.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Rental, as set out in the official list of tariffs, is payable on signing the booking form at the Facility
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: Manager’s office.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: No keys are to be handed to the applicants to lock or open the facility. Ad hoc arrangements will be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: made for kitchen facilities (if applicable).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 23"]

text: TUT is hereby exempted from any claim which, for whatever reason, arises from the use of the

text: Policy on HIV/AIDS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: It is TUT policy to eliminate unfair discrimination based on a person’s HIV status, to promote an
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: environment in which staff and students living with HIV are without fear of rejection, stigma or isola-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: tion, and to enable the holistic and integrated management of the pandemic.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Application and scope of policy
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: The policy applies to all students of TUT, including the distant learning sites, for the duration of their
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: period of study at the University. The policy also applies to part-time and postgraduate students.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Definitions in the policy
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: In this document, unless the context indicates otherwise –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: (a)  “AIDS” means acquired immune deficiency syndrome, which is a disease caused through
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: infection with the human immunodeficiency virus;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: (b)  “confidentiality” means confining knowledge on a need-to-know basis;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: (c)  “disclosure” means having to reveal one’s HIV status (voluntarily);
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: (d)  “HIV” means human immunodeficiency virus, which causes diseases;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: (e)  “immune deficiency” means weakening of the immune system;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: “informed consent” means a decision or approval to test for HIV on the basis of access to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: relevant and accurate information;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: (g)  “life skills” means acquired and cultivated abilities essential for successful inter- and intra-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: personal functioning;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: (h)  “MTCT” means mother-to-child transmission;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Chapter 24
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: “STI”  means  sexually  transmitted  infection  through  unprotected  sexual  intercourse  (e.g.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: thrush, gonorrhoea, syphilis);
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: “syndrome” means a collection of diseases;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: (k)  “transmission” means method by which HIV is passed on;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: “USP” means universal safety precautions; barrier methods of avoiding contact with contami-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: nated body fluids;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: (m)  “VCT” means voluntary counselling and testing; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: (n)  “wellness programme” means a programme that focuses on a person’s total physical and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: mental well-being.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: RULES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: The following rules will apply-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.1  HIV testing
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: No student will be required to undergo an HIV test. Should a student decide to undergo a test for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: any reason, the results will remain confidential. Should the test be accessed through the health
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: and wellness services, it will be done with the patient’s informed consent and with adherence to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: counselling legislation (Department of Health). All clients must receive pre- and post-test counsel-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: ling by a trained counsellor. Free, confidential and voluntary testing will be provided.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.2  Consent
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: All students must be permitted to make informed decisions about the test. Informed consent implies
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: access to relevant and accurate information about the procedure, the consequences of testing and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: what the result could mean for the client, and, finally, the client’s agreement to undergo the test.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.3  Confidentiality
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: All students have a legal right to confidentiality. No one is obliged to reveal, for any reason, his or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: her HIV status. HIV test results are treated confidentially by the counsellor. Should a staff member,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: student or peer educator disclose the HIV status of another person, disciplinary measures may be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: taken against him or her. Should disclosure be warranted, this may only be done with the express,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: informed and written consent of the individual concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.4  Disclosure
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: No student is obliged to disclose his or her HIV status, but students should take all reasonable and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: necessary precautions to prevent infecting others with whom they may interact. The University will
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: encourage disclosure to appropriately and professionally trained people, so as to access support,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: care and management, if needed. A climate will be fostered in which people living with HIV/AIDS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: will feel secure and supported, should they decide to disclose their status.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.5  Universal safety precautions
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Universal safety precautions must be adhered to in order to prevent occupational exposure.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.6  Counselling
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Students shall have access to counselling, care and support in keeping with the human and financial
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: capacity of the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.7  Primary health care
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: All students shall have  access to primary health care services, including services regarding sexual
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: and reproductive health, contraceptive information and counselling, pregnancy testing and TOP
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: counselling,  sexually  transmitted  infections,  information  and  syndrome  management  and  HIV
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: information, testing and counselling. These services shall be provided at all health and wellness
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: centres across TUT.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.8  Rape, sexual abuse, drug use and violence
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: TUT is aware of the incidence of rape, sexual abuse and violence on its campuses and makes every
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: possible effort both to prevent these practices and to provide students with access to information,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: counselling, support and HIV medication (within the financial capacity of the University).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Chapter 24
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.9  Gender issues
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: TUT recognises the fact that women are particularly vulnerable to HIV infection by virtue of the bio-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: logical characteristics of the infection, as well as, in some contexts, their perceived (by themselves
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: and/or others) psycho-social position. Hence, they shall be given attention in all awareness, training
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: and education programmes.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Seminars and campaigns are free of charge and student participation is encouraged.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.10  Education and research
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: All students shall have access to HIV/AIDS education and awareness programmes. These pro-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: grammes focus on providing information and teaching skills and enabling students to live, work and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: interact with people living with HIV.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: All faculties and departments shall be required to consider how to achieve integration of HIV/AIDS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: into the curriculum at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: The  Directorate  of  Health  and  Wellness  shall  actively  promote  and  support  HIV/AIDS-related
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: research.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.11  Grievance procedures
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Students shall have access to grievance procedures (available in the University structures), should
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: their rights be violated in any way.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.12  Student admission
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Based on the principles of non-discrimination, no students may be denied access to the University
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: on the basis of their HIV status. This includes access to academic programmes, social events,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: residences, bursaries, financial assistance and support programmes. Hence, students will not be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: required to undergo HIV tests prior to admission or in the course of their academic life at TUT.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: 24.5.4.13  Occupational exposure
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Should students be studying for a qualification where a risk exists for occupational exposure, the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: relevant department shall provide information, education and the necessary infection control equip-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: ment and procedures.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: constitutes official University policy.

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Students who participate in sports, camps, tours, excursions, activities or projects of the Tshwane
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: University of Technology do so at their own risk, and the University will accept no responsibility
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: whatsoever for any consequences of such participation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: Excursions, tours and camps undertaken on behalf of the University may be organised only with
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: the case of events of a purely academic nature or events undertaken for training purposes, the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 24"]

text: head of the academic department concerned will be the responsible person.

text: GENERAL INFORMATION
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: To be considered for funding in any academic year, the applicant must ensure to follow due proces-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: ses and comply with the terms and conditions stipulated and applicable to each funding category.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: Failing to do so will result in the application not being considered. As a general rule, no late or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: incomplete applications will be accepted.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: Please  consult  the  Financial Aid  website  at  www.tut.ac.za/students/financial  for  updated  and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: relevant information with regard to funding opportunities and application requirements.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: AVAILABLE FUNDING
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: External funding
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: This refers to bursaries that are allocated to students from sources outside of the University. These
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: include undergraduate and postgraduate bursaries from public, private, corporate/industry, govern-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: ment, parastatals and international sources. Please consult our website for more information on
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: possible funding opportunities.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: Internal University funding
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: Internal awards are allocated to any bona fide student from first-time entering students to post-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: graduate students who enrol at the University. It is the University’s intention to attract and retain
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: quality students by rewarding excellent academic and non-academic performance.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: It also serves the purpose of general support to students on merit as outlined by the specific policy
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: that governs the funding category. For further details on the application and allocation criteria of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: these bursaries, please refer to the financial aid website mentioned above.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: The  National  Student  Financial Aid  Scheme  (NSFAS)  provides  financial  aid  opportunities  from
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: various sources to academically deserving and financially needy students who wish to study at
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: tertiary  education  institutions.  The  following  provides  general  information  on  NSFAS.  However,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: please consult the NSFAS website at www.nsfas.org.za, as well as the University website for more
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: information.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.1  Students need to apply online and create or register an account. He or she must ensure to retain
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: the application reference number for future enquiries. In order to receive a reference number, the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: system must “save” the application. The reference number should be kept safe as it is the only
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: proof that a student has applied for NSFAS funding.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.2  The  NSFAS  website  (www.nsfas.org.za)  contains  future  updates  in  this  regard.  Students  must
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: ensure not to miss the deadline or to wait until the last day.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.3  Who should apply?
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: -  Students who are South African citizens.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: -  Students whose combined family income is less than R350 000 per annum, and in cases of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: students living with a disability, the combined income is less than R600000 per annum.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: -  All  new applicants (matriculants) or students who passed Grade 12 in previous years, but never
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: registered at any university.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: -  Students who have never received NSFAS funding.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: If a student applied for, and received funding in any particular year, he or she need to re-apply
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: each year, ensure to visit NSFAS website for clear instructions. Continued funding for the sub-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: sequent years is based on a student's academic performance in the year that funding was
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: received.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: Chapter 25
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: -  However, if a student does not register in the subsequent year of funding and has taken a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: “gap year”, a student will be required to re-apply.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.4  All students funded from the 2016 academic year onwards must register on the NSFAS website to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: verify their details.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.5  Continued funding will depend on the student’s annual academic performance determined by the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: NSFAS Eligibility Criteria.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.6  Additional assistance can be provided to current and prospective students who would like to apply
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: online, but do not have access. Please contact the local Financial Aid Office for more information
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.7  Any student who needs assistance with their application are requested to ensure they bring all the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: necessary documents to apply (consult the NSFAS website for a checklist of these documents).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.8   Access to any of the University campuses will only be granted on presentation of proof that the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: student applied for admission at TUT. This is also dependent on the Disaster Management Act,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 2005 (Act No. 53 of 2005), as amended for the Covid-19 pandemic protocols.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.9  Parents or guardians who accompany prospective students will also be required to present a valid
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: ID to gain access.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.10  All applicants must have a cell phone and valid e-mail address at hand in order to receive the “one-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: time pin (OTP)”. This will be needed to complete the application process.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.11  Applicants should visit the NSFAS website www.nsfas.org.za and follow the online instructions to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: submit information and to apply directly. Applicants should use their own cellphone number and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: e-mail address (and not that of their parents) as NSFAS will use this information for communication.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: Applicants should keep the reference number for enquiries, and update their details continuously
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: on NSFAS website as well as TUT biographical information.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.12  Please contact the local Financial Aid Office or NSFAS directly (if more information is required)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: at 0860 067 327, or visit  the website: www.nsfas.org.za, or e-mail to info@nsfas.org.za. for enquiries.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.13   The University will not make any funding decision as this will be done by NSFAS.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: Final confirmation of the outcome of applications will be provided by the University based
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: on this decision by NSFAS. It is therefore imperative that applicants follow the application
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: processes and provide the required documentation before the closing dates. Applicants are
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: further encouraged to track their NSFAS applications at www.nsfas.org.za.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: 25.2.3.14  CONTACT DETAILS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: For any enquiries regarding Financial Aid, please see below contact numbers per Campus, or visit
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: the University website under the specific link - https://www.tut.ac.za/bursaries-and-loans/contact-us
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 25"]

text: and select the “Log a Query” tab, to send an e-mail.

text: 26.5.1.2  Library users are responsible for all library information resources issued in their name. In the case
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: of theft of, damage to, or loss of any such resources, the users will be liable for the replacement
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: cost of the item(s).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.1.3  Fines are imposed on overdue loans. Library users must observe the due date  that is stamped on
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: the date slip on the first page of a book, or, where an item does not have a due date, observe the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: due date as specified under rule 26.5.1.1 above for books, continuing resources, multimedia, and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: the reserved/study collections.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.1.4  Overdue information resources
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.1.4.1  All library users are subject to overdue loan fines as set by the University's LIS and reflected in the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: annual tariff list; and penalties will be charged for resources kept beyond the loan expiry date or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: time without renewal.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.1.4.2  Two (2) printed or electronic reminders shall be sent to defaulters, after which information resources
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: not returned shall be regarded as lost and replacement charges levied. Non-receipt of reminders
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: is  not  an  excuse  for  not  settling  overdue  fines.  It  is  the  responsibility  of  the  user  to  update  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: institution  of  the  user's  change  of  contact  details.  Contact  the  library  for  more  information
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: regarding such cases.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.1.4.3  If a library user fails to pay the replacement fee and overdue fines mentioned in rule 26.5.1.4.2 –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: The examination results of the student shall be withheld.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Legal action will be taken against the user.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.1.5  Renewal of loans of information resources
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.1.5.1  Borrowers may request an extension of the loan period for items borrowed, before the expiry of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: loan period. Requests for extensions may be made:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: By e-mail.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: In person.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Telephonically.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
