text: INTER-LIBRARY LOANS AND DOCUMENT DELIVERY
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.1  Document delivery/inter-library loan services provide postgraduate students and staff with access
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: to information resources that cannot be obtained from any TUT library by obtaining those resources
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: from external libraries or agencies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.2  The Inter-library loans services serve to support  the teaching, learning, research, projects and work
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: activities of the University by enhancing library information resources through provision of access
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: to resources held in external libraries and thus, shall not be used for personal/private purposes.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Inter-library loans shall be provided to selected categories of library members as reflected in the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Policy on Library Membership.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.4   A library user may not request items on inter-library loan on behalf of another.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.5  Library users may not collect borrowed information resources from the external libraries themselves,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: in order for all loans to be fully recorded by receiving libraries.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.6   The LIS subsidises the cost of inter-library loans, except in the case of subsequent requests for the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: same information resources by the same user.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.7   Requestors who fail to collect a returnable inter-library loan item before the loan period expires shall
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: be held liable for the costs incurred.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.8   Borrowers must return information resources to the inter-library loans office which handled their
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: request.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.9   Borrowers who want to renew returnable inter-library loans items shall contact the relevant inter-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: library loans office at least three (3) days before the loan period expires. Requests for renewals
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: made after the loan period expired shall not be accepted.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.10   Failure to return information resources on or before the due date shall result in the imposition of a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: late return fine that is levied per day as per the approved tariffs. The LIS shall maintain good rela-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: tions with external libraries by keeping to the due dates of loaned items.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.11  If a user fails to pay outstanding fines mentioned in rule 26.5.4.10, the library shall:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Temporarily suspend the user's inter-library loans privileges;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: •  Withhold the student’s examination results until outstanding fines are paid in full; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Legal action will be taken against the user.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.12   The electronic purchasing of information resources shall be done for selected categories of library
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: members as reflected in the Policy on Library Membership.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Chapter 26
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.13   A library member may not request the electronic purchasing of resources on behalf of another.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.14   The LIS reserves the right to impose a limit on the number of resources that are purchased elec-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: tronically on behalf of a user.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.15  The LIS shall not reimburse users who have electronically purchased resources in their own capacity.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.5.4.16  A student should contact the information librarian at his or her campus for more information on this
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: service.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: INTERNET CENTRES (I-CENTRES)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Each campus has an I-Centre either within the library or just outside the smaller libraries; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: I-Centres are located outside the libraries in TUT-owned student residences and elsewhere on
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: campus. The following services are available to students in the centres:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Access to word processing and other office software for the completion of projects and as-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: signments;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Access to electronic information resources and online learning material;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Access to online information searches;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Access to all TUT services, including TUT e-mail, Learning Management System, and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Enterprise Resource Planning systems to which they have been granted access;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Access to e-mail for both academic and personal purposes;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Mobile device usage workstations with access to charging outlets;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Access to Wi-Fi;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Access to printing, copying and scanning services;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: The provision of access to official, prescribed academic information and functionality is regarded
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: as priority;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: No gaming, viewing or downloading of videos for recreational purposes is allowed between
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 8:00 and 16:00, except in cases where the games are prescribed by an academic programme
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: and/or in aid of computer literacy;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Students are entitled to request basic technical and other research support assistance from
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: the staff working in the centres at no additional cost;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Additional services and consumables such as laminating and binding, large format printing,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: etc. are not provided on-site. LIS will attempt to source access to these services for students
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: at an additional cost; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: A predetermined period per day, per student, will apply between 8:00 and 16:00 with respect to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: using the computers in the centres, to afford everybody an opportunity. More time is allowed,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: should there be no demand; e.g., after hours and during recess.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Responsibilities of students:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Students using the centres are at all times subject to the policies, rules and regulations of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: TUT;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Conduct in I-Centres is also subject to rules as displayed in the centres;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Disciplinary action will be taken against students who contravene policies, rules and regula-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: tions of TUT whilst utilising the centres;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: All students must use their login credentials to authenticate their identity when accessing TUT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: resources and services to which they have been granted access;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: By logging onto TUT PCs, students acknowledge that TUT does not guarantee their privacy
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: and confidentiality when using the facilities and resources. They further acknowledge that they
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: agree to abide by all TUT policies, rules and regulations, and they consent that their activities
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: are being monitored when using the facilities and resources;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Students must not share their login credentials;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Students must use the service responsibly, ethically, and lawfully. Computer resources must
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: not be wasted or monopolised to the exclusion of other students;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: The utilisation of the facilities to deliberately create, store or forward mass e-mail messages,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: chain letters, computer viruses, and illegal copies of material protected by copyright is not
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: allowed; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Chapter 26
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: The creation, viewing, storage or forwarding of messages containing discriminatory, intimida-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: tory, derogatory, intolerant remarks or prejudice sharing based on race, religion, gender, age,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: sexual orientation, disability, belief, political opinion, culture, language, pornography, explicit
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: nudity, gross depictions and religious content is not allowed.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Contravention  of  the  above-mentioned  rules  may  result  in  disciplinary  action  taken  against  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: clients.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: FACILITIES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Library and Information Services offers a wide range of facilities, including the following:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Discussion rooms.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Photocopying, printing and scanning facilities.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Study facilities and training rooms.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: The type and nature of facilities vary from library to library. Contact a library staff member or visit
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: the LIS website (https://libraries.tut.ac.za) for the latest information on the availability and terms of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: use of facilities in a particular library.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: LIBRARY RULES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: The following rules are in force at all libraries and in the I-Centres:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: 26.8.1.1  Library clients are not allowed to:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Eat and drink in the library.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Smoke in the library or toilets.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Litter in the library.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Move furniture or equipment.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Use or answer the library’s telephones.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Make noise in the library or disturb other users unnecessarily (including but not limited to using
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: a cell phone).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Remove library information resources from the library without authorisation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Damage library information resources, furniture or equipment.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Use other library clients’ TUT identity cards.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Move beyond the exit point when the information resources security system is activated.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Book seats with bags when not in the library.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Prohibit other clients from occupying an empty seat.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Please contact the relevant library to find out if there are additional rules that apply to a particular
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: campus library.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Should a library client fail to comply with the rules mentioned in 26.8.1.1 and 26.8.2, TUT disciplinary
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: measures shall be taken against the client.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Neither the Tshwane University of Technology, nor any of its library staff members will assume any
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: liability for damage to or the theft of personal belongings of a library client or visitor.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: Chapter 26
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 26"]

text: CHAPTER 27
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: HIGHER EDUCATION DEVELOPMENT AND SUPPORT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: DIRECTORATE OF STUDENT DEVELOPMENT AND SUPPORT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Services provided
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: The Directorate facilitates academic success and provides psychological support services to stu-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: dents.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.1.1.1  Career-counselling programme
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: This service is offered to both prospective and registered students. Career guidance consultations
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: and psychometric assessments are available if one is not sure what career path to follow or requires
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: assistance with subject choices in Grade 10.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.1.1.2  Student profiling
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Students are assessed to identify potential academic risks and support students in reaching their
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: academic potential.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.1.1.3  English proficiency interventions
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: English  proficiency  interventions  aim  to  support  students  in  developing  their  English  grammar,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: reading, and writing skills.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.1.1.4  Academic coaching and study skills
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Students who are academically at-risk and underperforming have access to numerous developmental,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: support and remedial interventions to enhance learning and study strategies. Psychologists are
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: also available to assist students with psychological issues impacting on their academic success.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.1.1.5  Academic support for students living with disabilities
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: The Disability Labs are resource centres with assistive devices for students with special learning
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: needs. Academic support  provided to students living with disabilities includes support for alternate
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: modes of assessments and assistance with reasonable accommodations for learning.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.1.1.6  Life Skills workshops
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: The Life Skills workshops are designed to equip students with essential tools for personal well-being
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: and development. These workshops focus on enhancing students' ability to confidently navigate
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: university life and prepare for future challenges.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.1.1.7  Student mentorship training
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: The  Mentorship  Programme  aims  to  assist  students  with  the  academic-  social-  and  emotional
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: transition in the university and provides basic academic support to students.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.1.1.8  Personal counselling and therapy
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Personal counselling and therapy services are available on all campuses as well as online and is
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: provided by professional mental health practitioners. The personal counselling and therapy inter-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: vention focuses on all types of mental health difficulties and issues that have an impact on mental
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: wellbeing and daily functioning. A 24-hour South African Depression and Anxiety Group (SADAG)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: emergency toll-free line (0800 68 78 88) is also available.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.1.1.9  Student Development and Support (SDS) Champions
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: The SDS Champion Programme enables students to serve their campus, and develop their personal
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: and employability skills. The programme includes training, group and individual supervision sessions,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: participation in outreach programmes, mental health exhibitions and expos, project management,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: DIRECTORATE OF COOPERATIVE EDUCATION

text: Services rendered
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: The Directorate’s focus is on supporting and assisting the students regarding Work-Integrated
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Learning (WIL) and student occupational support and employability skills, thereby equipping them
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: to enter the world of work. These critical areas are supported by the following:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: The WIL component that forms part of the curriculum, and enables the student to obtain his
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: or her diploma.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Directorate of Cooperative Education and Faculty Assistant Deans (Teaching, Leading,  Lear-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: ning and Technology) in collaboration with WIL academic staff, provides support to students,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: staff and employers on cooperative education and WIL activities.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Student occupational support and employability skills workshops, which assist and enable
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: students to apply the necessary skills when entering the world of work.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Work-Integrated Learning (WIL)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.1    When WIL is a requirement for a programme, a student may register and pay the required registra-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: tion only when he or she has obtained approval from the relevant Head of Department.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.2  A student may only register for WIL after his or her proposed registration has been approved by
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: the Head of the Academic Department concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.3  A student must provide proof of placement before registration; under conditions where he or she
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: cannot find placement within the prescribed dates, such a student will be allowed to register late
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: and will be exempted from late registration penalties.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.4  A student must complete all the required WIL periods to the satisfaction of the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.5  A student must pass all the required compulsory and chosen modules/subjects and the WIL
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: component in order to obtain sufficient credits for the qualification concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.6  Students are required to register for every period of WIL.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.7  WIL may take place only at an employer approved by TUT. Although the Tshwane University of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Technology undertakes to assist students with placement for WIL. The University undertakes to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: assist students with WIL placement in industry.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.8  Students may be given exemption for a maximum of one (1) semester (i.e. six (6) months) of WIL
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: completed prior to formal instruction, subject to the following conditions:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.9  The WIL must immediately precede the formal instruction.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.10   The student must comply with the set admission requirements, and he or she must be evaluated
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: for the programme concerned before registration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.11   The WIL may not exceed 50% of the total WIL period required.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.12   Rules 3.1 and 3.3 shall apply.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.13  The Head of the Department should approve and accept the WIL.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: 27.2.1.1.14   A student who did WIL at an employer while he or she was a registered student at another higher
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: educational institution may obtain exemption for such Work-Integrated Learning in terms of the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: rules for exemption and subject to the approval of the Head of the Department.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Chapter 27

["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: STUDENT EMPLOYABILITY SKILLS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Only registered students at the Tshwane University of Technology are assisted through the occupa-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: tional support and employability skills services. The services consist of the following:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Compiling a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV), portfolio or resumé.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Employment search strategies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Interview and presentation skills.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Professional ethics.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Teamwork.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Career Expos.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Students are also reminded that this is a free service. The Directorate cannot guarantee successful
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: employment. The Directorate of Cooperative Education and TUT are not responsible for any agree-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: ment between a student and an employer.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: SPECIALISED RECRUITMENT DRIVES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Employers are encouraged to utilise this initiative on campus and to introduce their companies to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: students on campus. These recruitment drives –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: give prospective employers an opportunity to present a multimedia overview to students of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: their choice on what they have to offer to prospective employees;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: give students an opportunity to ask relevant questions after seeing the company presentation;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: give  students  an  opportunity  to  meet  with  employees  of  the  company  in  a  structured  and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: informal manner;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: give  students  valuable  and  relevant  information  on  how  to  apply  for  an  appointment  at  a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: company and to familiarise themselves with the recruiting company’s criteria; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: give companies an opportunity to meet the academics concerned at the respective depart-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: ments to establish long-term relationships, and share and exchange valuable information.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Please note that this is a service to the students and industry that is rendered by the Directorate of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Cooperative Education. The Directorate will try its utmost to meet any written request from prospec-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: tive employers regarding recruitment; however, we cannot guarantee that we will always be able to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: honour such requests.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: DIRECTORATE OF TEACHING AND LEARNING WITH TECHNOLOGY
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Services rendered
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: The Directorate of Teaching and Learning with Technology's (TLwT) focus is on the establishment
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: of a technology-enhanced teaching and learning environment. This includes the design, develop-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: ment, hosting, empowerment and integration of educational technology in the curriculum.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: These critical areas are supported by the following:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Providing  a  stable  learning  management  system,  namely  myTUTor,  for  access  to  online
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: teaching and learning material.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Providing access to online resources such as eBooks, plagiarism with Artificial Intelligence
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: (AI) detection, monitoring and proctoring for secure online assessments, etc.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Implementation of educational technology as minimum standards in classrooms.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Designing and developing support material such as graphics and videos.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Instructional  design  of  digital  content  to  be  hosted  on  myTUTor.  Content  development  is
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: aligned with the curriculum and learning outcome and assessment requirements.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Staff and student orientation in the navigation of myTUTor ensures proficiency and effective-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: ness in the application of the system features.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: Empowerment in the use of educational technology and its applications especially educational
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: technology in the classrooms. This is available for both staff and students.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 27"]

text: THE PURPOSE OF THE OFFICE OF THE STUDENT OMBUDSMAN
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: The Office of the Student Ombudsman provides registered TUT students with a service for addressing
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: any academic complaints they might have. The main purpose of this service is to offer advocacy,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: counselling and support to students with regard to all teaching-, learning- and assessment- and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: supervision related problems the students experience.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: The role of the Student Ombudsman is one of a ‘last resort’. That is, the Ombudsman will inter-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: vene in a complaint only when all responsible academic line management and other avenues for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: resolving the matter have been exhausted.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: DEFINITIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: In this chapter unless otherwise indicated –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: “academic complaint” refers to any complaint that students may have with regard to teaching,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: learning, research, academic support and postgraduate supervision;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: “academic line management” refers to the area of the University or member (s) of staff responsi-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: ble  for  delivering  service  or  conducting  the  process  about  which  the  complaint  is  made. These
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: include lecturers, programme coordinators, heads of departments, executive deans, DVC: Teaching,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Learning and Technology (DVC: TLT) and DVC: Postgraduate Studies, Research and Innovation
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: (DVC: PRI);
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: “complainant” refers to a person making a complaint;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: “formal complaint” refers to a written complaint, signed by the complainant and addressed to any
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: responsible manager;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: “local level” means the area of the University or its staff member(s) responsible for delivering
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: service or conducting the process about which the complaint is being made;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: “non-completion student" refers to former TUT student with incomplete qualification but who is
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: not academically excluded but is not registered for the current academic year;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: “prospective student” refers to any individual who is interested in enrolling or has already formally
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: applied to enrol for a qualification presented by TUT;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: “respondent” means a person who responds to a complaint;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: "the  Office  of  the  Student  Ombudsman"  is  a  mechanism  of  adjudicating  students’  academic
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: complaints as an independent but integral part of the grievance resolution procedures at TUT; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: “vexatious complaint” means complaints that are frivolous and or deliberately intended to annoy
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: or bring distress and suffering to other parties.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: AREAS THAT THE OFFICE OF THE STUDENT OMBUDSMAN DOES NOT COVER
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Complaints lodged by prospective students (non-enrolled students).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Students who are not registered and are applying for Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Allegations of sexual harassment, unfair discrimination or racism (refer to TUT policy or regula-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: tory mechanisms on sexual harassment, policy on unfair discrimination, or policy on racism
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: for both staff and students).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: •     Disciplinary measures taken against a student for whatever reason in another environment
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: (refer to Chapter 15).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Chapter 28
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: •      Academic exclusions on the basis of unsatisfactory academic progress.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Non-academic complaints by members of staff who are also students at TUT (refer to TUT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Human Resources policy on grievances).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Complaints about accommodation and residences (refer to policy or regulations guiding
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: practices  and  processes  in  the  Student  Affairs  and  Extracurricular  Development  (SAED)
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: environment).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Complaints about enrolment and registration processes. Such complaints should be directed
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: to Academic Administration.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: PROCEDURES FOR LODGING A COMPLAINT AND REPORTING MECHANISMS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: A student with a complaint shall personally contact the office of the Student Ombudsman at the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Directorate of Quality Promotion or may be accompanied by a class representative or a member
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: of the Student Representative Council (SRC).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: The complainant shall ensure that he or she has tried to resolve the matter with all other stakehol-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: ders such as the lecturer concerned, head of academic department, Executive Dean of the Faculty
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: or whoever in the environment the complaint emanates from.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: The office of the Student Ombudsman shall only investigate the complaint when the complainant
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: has provided evidence that all relevant academic departments and faculty complaints management
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: processes have been exhausted and the complaint was not resolved satisfactorily.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: The Ombudsman shall then assess the merit of the case whether it warrants to be investigated or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: be referred elsewhere.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: The complaint shall be dismissed if the Student Ombudsman is of the opinion that:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: (a)  The complaint is vexatious.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: (b)  The complaint is a fake and riddled with all sorts of lies.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: (c)  The incidence occurred at too remote a time to warrant inquiry.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: (d)  There exists an alternative  and satisfactory  means  of addressing the complaint  within  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: University. In such a case, the Student Ombudsman may give advice to a complainant as to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: other internal avenues for addressing the matter concerned.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: If the complainant is subject to a disciplinary hearing or appeal processes within the University,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: the Student Ombudsman shall proceed no further inquiring into the complaint until the hearing
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: or appeal has been finalised.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: (f)  The student is rude, unprofessional and uses derogatory language towards staff implicated
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: in the matter, be it verbally or in written form.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: (g)  The student does not have any documentary evidence such as scripts, assignments or written
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: communiqué between him or her with the implicated persons to substantiate  his or her allega-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: tions.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: 28.4.6  Where a complaint warrants further investigation, the steps outlined below shall be followed.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: The student lodging a complaint shall be required to:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: (a)  put in writing the nature of the complaint and all other internal processes that he or she has
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: exhausted before approaching the Office of the Student Ombudsman; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: (b)  fill in a complaint form; indicating, amongst others, the following information:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: the  student’s  personal,  academic  and  contact  details,  preferably  a  working  TUT4life
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: e-mail address;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: whether  the  student  tried  to  resolve  the  matter  with  any  other  structure  such  as  the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: lecturer concerned, Head of the Department or the Departmental Administrator;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: a narrative of the “actual” nature of the complaint;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: how he or she would like the problem to be solved; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: any supporting documentation that shall serve as evidence, e.g. test scripts, study guides,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: assignments and projects.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Chapter 28
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: If a student requests to be anonymous due to a possibility of victimisation and/or other negative
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: consequences for the student, the Student Ombudsman may commence with an inquiry without
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: the matter being handled at local level first.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Upon completion of a complaint form, the Student Ombudsman shall start investigating the case.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: 28.4.10  Upon completion of the investigation, the complainant shall be provided with feedback.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: The complainant shall timeously inform the Student Ombudsman whether the verdict of the Ombuds-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: man is implemented or not, so that the Ombudsman can be in a position to monitor and evaluate
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: the implementation of the recommendations and verdict.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: HOW TO CONTACT THE STUDENT OMBUDSMAN
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: The  Office  of  the  Student  Ombudsman  is  situated  at  the  Pretoria  Campus,  in  the  Dinokeng
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: Building, 4th floor, room 428. The telephone number is 012 382 5525/5085 or the students can
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: e-mail the office of the Student Ombudsman at ombudsman@tut.ac.za.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 28"]

text: CHAPTER 29
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: STUDENTS WITH DISABILITIES AND SPECIAL NEEDS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: The University is committed to the fair and equal treatment of all individuals, and, as an institution
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: of higher learning, strives towards an inclusive mode of education.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: TUT acknowledges that people with disabilities and special needs have the same right to reach their
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: academic and professional potential as those who do not have a disability. TUT is thus legally and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: morally bound and committed to a reasonable course of action that will increase its accessibility to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: students with disabilities.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: All actions resulting from the implementation of the Policy on Students with Disabilities and Special
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: Needs will be governed by the financial capacity of the University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: The Directorate of Student Development and Support (SDS) provides the student community with a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: service for students with disabilities. The main purpose of this service is to offer advocacy, counsel-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: ling and academic support to students with disabilities.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: DEFINITIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: In this chapter, unless otherwise indicated –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: (a)  “prospective student” means any individual who is interested in enrolling or has already
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: formally applied to enrol for a qualification presented by TUT;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: (b)  “relevant academic department" means the department that offers the academic qualifica-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: tion for which the prospective student wishes to enrol, or for which an already enrolled student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: is registered;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: (c)  “service  for  students  with  disabilities”  means  the  service  for  students  with  disabilities
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: provided by the Directorate of Student Development and Support, as a formal bureau in the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: organisational structure of TUT;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: (d)  “student” means any individual who is formally registered as a student for a qualification
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: offered by TUT;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: (e)  “students  with  disabilities”  means  registered  students  who  have  long-term  or  recurring
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: physical or mental impairments  which in interaction with various attitudinal and environmental
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: barriers, may hinder their full and effective participation in society on an equal basis with oth-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: ers.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: Chapters 28 & 29
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: player in the organisational structure of TUT;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: Categories of disability

["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: The University accepts the responsibility to provide a morally and legally sound practice in provi-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: ding for and managing disabilities.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: The University will provide a Disability Office to facilitate and monitor all aspects stated in this
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: policy.

["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: way that it is offered to all students on University campuses.

["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: The University accepts the responsibility to inform the applicant on time of its ability to provide
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: RIGHTS AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: It is the right and responsibility of a prospective student with a disability or disabilities to declare
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: his or her disability or disabilities when he or she applies for admission to TUT, and to negotiate
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: support.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: It is the right and responsibility of a prospective student or current student with a disability or disa-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: bilities to acquaint him- or herself with all policies and procedures regarding disabilities.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: It is the responsibility of a student with a disability or disabilities to report a relevant grievance.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: If a student develops some form of disability during his or her period as a student at TUT, the student
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: and/or the academic department concerned must inform the Directorate of Student Development
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 29"]

text: and Support and Disability Unit if support, counselling or advocacy of any form will be necessary.
