text: DEFINITIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: In this chapter, unless otherwise indicated –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “accredited institution of higher education” means one of the following:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: A South African public institution of higher education.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: A private provider of higher education, registered with the Registrar of Private Higher Educa-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: tion Institutions, in accordance with section 54(2)(a)(i) of the Higher Education Act, 1997 (Act
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: No. 101 of 1997), as amended.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: An internationally accredited institution of higher education, accredited by its government as
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: an institution of higher education, that is included in relevant handbooks (such as the Inter-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: national Handbook of Universities, published in association with the International Association
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: of Universities).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: A  South African  college  for  Further  Education  and  Training  accredited  as  a  provider  with
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Umalusi, the Council for Quality Assurance in General and Further Education and Training;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Chapters 29 & 30
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “advanced qualifications” are the second or higher level of qualifications offered; they typically
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: follow on “entry-level qualifications”;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “applicant” refers to a person who applies for or intends to apply for RPL or any other application
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: in terms of this policy. An applicant may be a current registered student (part-time or full-time) or a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: potential student;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “entry-level qualifications” are the first level of qualifications on the Higher Education Qualifica-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: tions Sub Framework (HEQSF), and they commence on level five (5) of the HEQSF. They include
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: qualifications such as higher certificates, diplomas, bachelor- and professional bachelor degrees
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: (Although these examples are provided with reference to the HEQSF framework of 2013, it is ac-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: knowledged that an interim transition period will exist where previous qualifications will also apply);
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “equivalence” is an award made to grant an applicant admission to a qualification based on the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: fact that the applicant’s qualification is at least 70% equivalent to the prerequisite qualification for
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: a specific programme;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “equivalent qualification” means a qualification, completed at an accredited institution of higher
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: education,  which  is  not  identical  to  the  admission  requirements  of  the  programme  but  which  is
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: evaluated to be on the same NQF Level, and of which the study content overlaps by at least 70%
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: with that of the set admission requirement qualification;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “formal learning” means learning that occurs in an organised and structured education and training
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: environment and that is explicitly designated as such. Formal learning leads to the awarding of a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: qualification or part qualification registered on the NQF;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “informal learning” means learning completed at any institutions other than “accredited institu-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: tions of higher education” or any non-credit-bearing learning completed at “accredited institutions
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: of higher education”;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “lifelong learning” means learning that takes place in all contexts in life from a life-wide, life-deep
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: and lifelong perspective. It includes learning behaviours and obtaining knowledge, understanding,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: attitudes, values and competences for personal growth, social and economic well-being, democratic
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: citizenship, cultural identity and employability;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “non-formal learning” means learning (competencies) achieved through life and/or work experi-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: ence and not via formal qualifications or credits;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: “Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)” means the principles and processes through which the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: prior knowledge and skills of a person are made visible, mediated and assessed for the purposes
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: of alternative access and admission, recognition and certification, or further learning and develop-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: ment;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: 30.1.12   “prior learning” refers to the competencies currently held by the applicant, regardless of how,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: when or where the learning occurred. Such competencies may be attained in a number of ways
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: and include learning obtained through formal, informal and non-formal learning; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: 30.1.13   “status” means the recognition granted to an applicant to register for a programme if the applicant
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: is not the holder of the required admission qualification or an equivalent qualification, but is the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: holder of another qualification on the same NQF Level as that of the prerequisite qualification.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: RULES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Equivalence is an application for admission to a qualification based on the fact that the applicant’s
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: existing qualification is at least 70% similar to the prerequisite qualification, as stated in the admis-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: sion requirements for that programme (see 30.1.5 and 30.1.6).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Request to issue a qualification is an application based on an anomaly (a deviation from the norm
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: or from expectations) that prevents the issuing of a qualification. To merit the consideration of such
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: a request, special circumstances should prevail.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Chapter 30
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: RPL for advanced admission is an application for admission where the applicant does not meet the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: stated admission requirements but wishes to be admitted to an advanced qualification on the basis
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: of RPL. As part of a rigorous assessment process, the applicant would need to furnish evidence of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: exceptional experience, depth and scope before his or her application would be considered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: RPL for entry-level admission (with an NSC or a SC) is an application for admission into an entry-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: level  qualification  where  the  applicant  holds  a  Senior  Certificate,  National  Senior  Certificate  or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: equivalent qualification that fails to meet the specific admission requirements of the intended entry-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: level qualification 7. Applicants need to provide evidence of significant and relevant prior learning
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: before applications will be considered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: RPL for entry-level admission (without an NSC or a SC) is an application for admission into an entry-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: level qualification where the applicant does not hold a Senior Certificate, National Senior Certificate
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: or equivalent qualification, and where application is made for RPL to be granted on the basis of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: work experience, prior learning and maturity. Applicants need to provide evidence of significant and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: relevant prior learning before applications will be considered.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Status is an application to register for a programme when the applicant does not hold the required
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: admission qualification or an equivalent qualification, but holds another qualification on the same
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: NQF level as that of the prerequisite qualification (see 30.1.13).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: 30.2.7   Module/subject RPL is an application for recognition of a specific module(s)/subject(s) to obtain
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: RPL exemption for that module(s)/subject(s).
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: RULES REGARDING THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE APPLICANT
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: It  is  the  responsibility  of  the  applicant  to  provide  proof/evidence  of  prior  learning  and  acquired
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: competencies when applying for RPL. Such evidence must be submitted in a language that is in
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: accordance with the University’s language policy.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: 30.3.2    Applications for RPL must be submitted at least six (6) months prior to the intended date of registra-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: tion.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Applicants must adhere to the agreed target dates for submission of evidence, completion of activi-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: ties, or any other actions required to successfully complete the application process.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Applicants who have obtained qualifications outside the Republic of South Africa must include a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) Certificate of Evaluation of qualifications presented.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: RULES REGARDING TUT RESPONSIBILITIES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: TUT is responsible for providing counselling and guidance to the applicant regarding the prepara-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: tion of evidence for RPL applications.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: TUT is responsible for processing applications in a timely, clear and transparent manner.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: RULES RELATED TO APPEALS BY APPLICANTS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Appeals should be submitted within ten (10) working days of receipt of the decision by the applicant.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: An applicant may appeal against a decision if s/he feels dissatisfied with the process or assessment
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: decision.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: RULES RELATED TO ASSESSMENT FOR RPL
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Assessment for RPL must be done in compliance with the TUT policy on assessment and modera-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: tion.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Chapter 30
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: Assessment for RPL must focus on previously acquired competencies, not on current teaching and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: learning practices.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: 30.6.3   When applications for module/subject RPL are approved, results on the academic record will be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: reflected as “RPL exemption” and no marks will be allocated.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 30"]

text: CHAPTER 31
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: STUDENT PROTESTS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: DEFINITIONS
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: In this chapter, unless otherwise indicated –
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: “Protest” means the act of making a strong public expression of disagreement and disapproval or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: the display of objection to an issue designed to express an opinion and/or generate public and/or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: media attention. This may take a number of forms, including marches, pickets, rallies, occupations,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: etc.;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: “Protest leaders” means those people who are nominated by the group to, or hold themselves to,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: or are deemed to, have responsibility for the organisation of the protest;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: “Protestors” means those people who participate in favour of the protest (recognising that there
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: may be groups within a protest or more than one protest simultaneously);
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: “SRC” means the Student Representative Council of the Tshwane University of Technology;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: “University” means  the Tshwane University of Technology (TUT), as duly constituted in terms of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: the provisions of the Higher Education Act, 1997 (Act No. 101 of 1997), as amended; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: “University management or management” means the vice-chancellor, deputy vice-chancellors,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: registrar, executive deans, executive directors, chief financial officer and any other position equivalent
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: to or above that of an executive director.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: RULES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Any actions, which interfere with the operation of the University or with the rights of others, constitute
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: grounds for disciplinary action. Interfering actions include, but are not limited to, the blocking of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: access to classrooms or to buildings or the unauthorised occupancy of any University building or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: any part thereof either during or after hours of operation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Protests that infringe upon the rights of others to peaceful assembly, orderly protest, free exchange
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: of ideas, or that interfere with the rights of others to make use of or enjoy the facilities or attend the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: functions of the University shall not be permitted.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Protest action should be non-violent and the protestors must avoid actions that cause harassment
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: or physical harm to any person or subject a person to abuse or intimidation or cause them to be
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: fearful for their own safety or the safety of others; and actions that cause or are likely to cause
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: damage to any property.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Protest actions may only be held on the University premises provided there is permission from
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Management.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: If a person protests, he or she has to follow the rules of the Public Gathering Act, 1993 (Act No.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: 205 of 1993) and other laws of South Africa.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Chapters 30 & 31
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: There are a number of locations that protesters will not be permitted to occupy under any circum-
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: stances. Any occupation of those sites will result in immediate notification of trespass, a warning to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: leave and subsequent removal if the protestors neglect or refuse to do so. These include, but are
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: not limited to, the following types of locations:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -   Laboratories, dangerous sites or sites where dangerous goods are stored;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -   Sites where communication and/or information technology services are controlled;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -   Sites where confidential information is located; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  Sites involving cash handling or where significant finances are controlled.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Individual staff offices;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: In the interest of the well-being of its community and the safeguarding of its property or property
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: that it holds in trust, the University will not tolerate some activities or situations. These include, but
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: are not limited to the following:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  Road blockades, sit-ins and unreasonable prevention of staff and students from conducting
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: their lawful business;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  Protesters forcing anyone to be a part of the protest and the intimidation or harming of staff or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: other persons lawfully on University land or buildings;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  Protesters saying or singing anything, or carrying something with writing on it, like a placard or
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: a banner or a poster, that might cause hatred or violence to anyone or any group of people
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: because of their race, language, religion, gender or culture;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -   Protesters saying or doing anything that is likely to cause violence against anyone, and cannot
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: do anything which stops peace or goes against the rights of others;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  Protesters dressed like someone from the police or army;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  Protesters wearing a mask or paint or anything else that hides their face;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  Damage to University property, including intellectual and electronic property or threats to system
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: integrity and denial of service, including interference with security, laboratory and fire safety
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: systems of the University;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  Any criminal act or other breach of any statute or regulation, risk to the health, welfare and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: safety of any persons; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  Carrying of dangerous weapons during demonstrations.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: PROCEDURES
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Notice of Intent and Authorisation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: 31.3.1.1  Students planning to hold a protest action should submit a three (3) working days’ written notice of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: intent to the University management specifying the time, place and manner of the demonstration
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: along with a general plan for protest action. The notice should be signed and contain the names,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: addresses and telephone numbers of the protest leaders of the protest action.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: 31.3.1.2  The notice of intent does not imply an approval process, but rather a consultative process that
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: promotes the rights and responsibilities of the students and University.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: 31.3.1.3  Upon notification of a protest, the University management will provide the protest leaders with a
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: copy of this policy and consult with them to establish reasonable parameters of time, place, and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: manner in which the protest action may take place. The University reserves the authority to protect
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: the rights and safety of the community and not authorise the event.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: 31.3.1.4  The  protest  action  may  only  take  place  after  a  formal  written  permission  has  been  granted  by
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: management. Permission may not be unreasonably withheld. In order to determine whether the
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: decision of management to withhold the permission is reasonable, the University management will
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: take the following factors into account:
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: The number of protesters taking part;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: The area designated for the protest action;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -   The proposed movement of people participating in the protest action;
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Chapter 31
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: The proposal by the SRC to exercise control over the protest action; and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: The conduct of protesters.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: 31.3.1.5  The University authorities will appoint a person or persons to liaise between the University and
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: protestors. The protest leaders would be asked to similarly nominate a liaison person or persons.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: The purpose of a liaison person is to enable avenues of communication during the protest and to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: negotiate in good faith a resolution to the situation.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Involvement of Police and other external parties by TUT.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: The University authorities will endeavour to resolve protests without involving the South African
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Police Service (SAPS) and/or other relevant external parties.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  However, the Vice-Chancellor or his/her delegate reserves the right to invite the Police on to
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: University property for any reason, and particularly when any of the prohibited activities arise.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: -  Campus Protection Services (CPS) are to enforce any and all relevant policies and Legislation,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: report and record any and all transgressions and liaise with Student Judiciary in the event of
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: policy and legislatory breaches during and after protest actions.
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: THE MEDIA
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]
["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: Media access is permitted on request to the Director: of Corporate Affairs and Marketing. However,
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: the University reserves the right to withhold or withdraw this permission with respect to any or all
section_path: ["STUDENTS' RULES AND REGULATIONS", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS", "CHAPTER 31"]

text: of the University’s premises at any time.

text: Please Note:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 1.  Although the information in this Prospectus has been compiled as accurately as possible, the Council
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: accepts no responsibility for any inaccuracies in this publication. This Prospectus is valid for 2026 only.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 2.  Life Orientation and an achievement Level of 1 in a subject are not considered in the calculation of the
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Admission Point Score (APS).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 3.  Prospective students will not be admitted to any qualification without prior evaluation.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 4.  The indicated non-refundable administration fee and certified copies of the applicant's identity document,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Senior  Certificate/National  Senior  Certificate  and  all  other  relevant  documents  must  accompany  the
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: completed application form or online application.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 5.  The closing dates for admissions are available on the University website.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 6.  A student must complete a qualification at the learning site where he/she was accepted and is registered.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A transfer between sites will only be allowed if the student follows the following process:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A formal request must be submitted to the academic manager/Head of the Department on the current
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: learning site before the second Friday in May (to be considered for transfer in July of the same
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: year) or the second Friday in October (to be considered for a transfer in January of the following
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: year). The request must contain the reasons for the transfer.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A committee will meet shortly after each of the closing dates for submissions to consider every
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: request on merit, keeping in mind the availability of space and the adherence to enrolment quotas
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: on respective learning sites. Students will be informed of the outcome.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Important:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: TUT admission requirements for entry-level programmes adhere to national legislation, and therefore, the
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: following are required:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Bachelor’s degrees: at least four subjects at performance level 4.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: •  Diplomas: at least four subjects at performance level 3.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Applicants must verify the specific requirements for each programme as indicated in the Prospectus.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ACCEPTANCE IS SUBJECT TO AVAILABLE CAPACITY ACCORDING TO THE STUDENT
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ENROLMENT PLAN (SEP)
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Alternative  and  international  qualifications  (HIGSCE,  IGCSE,  NSSC A&O  Level,  IB  Higher  and  Standard
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Level, etc.) are dealt with in a specific manner:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: •  While there is a legal imperative to submit the certificate of equivalence (issued by SAQA or the CHE),
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: it is recommended that the application process be initiated while the application for the certificate is in
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: process.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The Tshwane University of Technology cannot obtain this certificate on the applicant's behalf.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: FOR APPLICANTS WITH A NATIONAL CERTIFICATE (VOCATIONAL) AT NQF LEVEL 4:

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: endorsement, with at least 50% (APS of 4) for English (first additional language) and 60%
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: (excluded for APS calculation), and 50% (APS of 4) for any other three compulsory vocational
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: of at least 26 (with Mathematics) or 28 (with Mathematical Literacy). Applicants with a score of
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Transfer between Learning Sites:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A student must complete a qualification at the learning site where he/she was accepted and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: is registered. A transfer between sites will only be considered if the student follows the following
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: process: A formal request must be submitted to the Academic manager/Head of the Depart-
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ment on the current learning site by the second Friday in October (to be considered for a
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: transfer in January of the following year). The request must contain the reasons for the transfer.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: experiences as well as to complete assignments and projects. NSFAS students receive an
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: success. Students are encouraged to consult the faculty website where the minimum require-
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ments for specific programmes are published.

text: a.  Admission requirement(s):
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A National Diploma: Information Technology in the field of Technical Applications, or Software
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Development,  or  Web Application  Development,  or  a  Diploma  in  Computer  Science,  or  a
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: relevant bachelor’s degree, or an equivalent qualification in Computer Science or Software
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Engineering at NQF Level 6 with a minimum of 360 credits. Prospective students are required
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: to have knowledge of advanced JAVA programming.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Holders  of  any  other  equivalent  South  African  or  international  qualification  may  also  be
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: considered, see Chapter 1 of Students’ Rules and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: b.  Selection criteria:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Admission is subject to selection. Prospective students will be evaluated based on the marks
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: obtained in their previous qualification and/or work experience.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Acceptance is subject to available capacity according to the Student Enrolment Plan (SEP).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Applicants will be informed of their status per an official letter from the Office of the Registrar,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: alternatively, they can check their application status on the TUT website, www.tut.ac.za.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: c.  Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), equivalence and status:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Information on the rules and the process to follow is available in Chapter 30 of Students’ Rules
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Intake for the qualification:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: January only.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: e.  Presentation:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Day classes offered on Saturdays over a period of two years.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: f.   Minimum duration:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A minimum of one or two years (depending on the programme presentation).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: g.  Exclusion and readmission:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: See Chapter 2 of Students’ Rules and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: h.  Re-registration:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The option to re-register for Integrated Software Project is subject to a student’s academic
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: performance. The purpose of the re-registration option is to provide students with an opportu-
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: nity to complete the final project only, and not to redo the whole module should they fail the
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: module.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Transfer between Learning Sites:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A student must complete a qualification at the learning site where he/she was accepted and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: is registered. A transfer between sites will only be considered if the student follows the following
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: process: A formal request must be submitted to the Academic manager/Head of the Department
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: on the current learning site by the second Friday in October (to be considered for a transfer
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: in January of the following year). The request must contain the reasons for the transfer.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Personal equipment:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Access  to  a  laptop  or  desktop  computer  is  essential  to  participate  in  multimodal  learning
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: experiences as well as to complete assignments and projects. NSFAS students receive an
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: allowance to acquire a laptop, and using this allowance for this purpose is critical for academic
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: success. Students are encouraged to consult the faculty website where the minimum require-
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ments for specific programmes are published.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: DIPLOMA IN COMPUTER SYSTEMS ENGINEERING
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The purpose of the programme:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The Diploma in Computer Systems Engineering is designed to build the necessary knowledge, understan-
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ding, abilities and skills required for further learning towards becoming a competent Practicing Engineering
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Technician Professional pathway.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: This  programme  consists  of  an  underpinning  of  mathematics  and  science.  Students'  knowledge  and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: understanding of mathematics and science will be of sufficient depth and breadth to underpin their computer
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: systems engineering education, to enable appreciation of its scientific and engineering context, and to support
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: their understanding of future developments. It is expected that this underpinning material will be taught in
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: an engineering context and, where appropriate, a computer systems engineering context. This programme
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: will have the following indicative science and mathematics modules: Mathematics 115, Mathematics 126,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Mathematics 216; and basic natural science, which is embedded in some of the engineering fundamental
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: modules, such as Electrical Principles 115 and Electronics 115.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The diploma is offered to students with no technical background and prepares them for work life. The diploma
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: further exposes students to the state-of-the-art miniaturised and mobile computer systems and smart device
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: technology, allowing them to acquire the complementary hardware and software knowledge and skills required
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: for understanding and designing such systems. Students will typically complete practical experiences and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: projects, allowing an opportunity to delve into real-world scenarios in the field of Computer Systems Engineering
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: as a registered learner technician with ECSA.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: In  addition  to  design-based  and  experiential  industrial  training  component  requirement,  students  will
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: complete modules, such as: Computer Architecture and Organisation; Databases; Digital Process Control;
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Electrical Principles;  Electronics;  Digital Electronics; Logic Design, Embedded Systems; Network Systems;
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Operating  Systems;  Probability  and  Statistics;  Project  Construction;  Programmable  Logic  Controllers;
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Programming; Software Engineering; and any three of the following: Artificial Intelligence, Mobile Robotics,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Network Systems.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Critical cross-field outcomes:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: This qualification standard specifies the following required knowledge areas: Exit Level Outcomes for the
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: diploma programme, and the minimum credit distribution required per knowledge area.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The Exit Level Outcomes guide the curriculum content as well as pedagogical and assessment decisions. The
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: programme  has  a  coherent  assembly  of  profession-specific  and  complementary  knowledge  areas,  and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: meaningful integration of the required skills and values.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: At each level (semester/year) there will be "integrative active learning activities". These are intended to develop
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: a range of skills (analytical reasoning, inquiry and research, information literacy, problem-solving, etc.), and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: an integration of different knowledge areas. These learning activities will be practiced extensively, across the
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: curriculum, in the context of progressively more challenging problems, projects, and standards for performance.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Students will have multiple opportunities throughout the programme to explore, develop and be assessed
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: on  the  various  competencies  from  the  level  of  novice  to  the  desired  level  of  competence  as  the  student
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: progresses in the programme.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: There is an increase in the level of cognitive, affective, and psychomotor complexity from the first year to the
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: final year to ensure an effective preparation for the real world of professional practice, and lifelong learning.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The diploma will be grounded in learning activities that will facilitate the development of key cognitive and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: practical skills (inquiry and analysis, critical and creative thinking, written and oral communication, information
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: literacy, teamwork and problem solving) required of an engineering student.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The curriculum is designed in such a way as to ensure a progressive and cumulative combination of the key
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: knowledge types in specific subject areas, to deepen and extend the preceding knowledge, whilst adding a
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: new element.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The programme consists of a coherent assembly of knowledge areas. The knowledge areas associated with
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: engineering practice (as specified in the Engineering Qualification Standard E-02-PN) include mathematics,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: natural sciences, engineering sciences, design and synthesis, computing and IT, and relevant complementary
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: studies. This assembly of knowledge areas provides a viable platform for further studies and lifelong learning
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: and enables development in traditional or emerging fields.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Curriculum Design Principles
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: This programme will include a coherent assembly of fundamental engineering sciences, design and principles
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: and applications, engineering practice and embedded issues of ethics, safety, communication, sustainability,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: etc. The diploma will have the following indicative content for the core principles and applications of Computer
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Systems Engineering:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Engineering Sciences:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Engineering Sciences consists of  two categories, namely, the general and discipline-specific modules. The
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: general  modules are: Databases  215; Network  Systems 125;  Operating Systems 226; Programming  126
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: and Programming 216.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The  discipline-specific  modules  are:  Artificial  Intelligence  226;  Computer  Architecture  and  Organisation
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 216;  Electrical  Principles  115;  Electronics  115,  Electronics  126;  Embedded  Systems  316;  Digital
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Electronics  115,  Digital  Electronics  126,  Digital  Electronics  216;  Digital  Process  Control  216,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Digital Process Control 226; Logic Design 226; Mobile Robotics 226; Network Systems 226; Programmable
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Logic Controllers 226; and Software Engineering 316.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Engineering Design and Synthesis:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: In Computer Systems Engineering, design and synthesis are the cumulative acquired theoretical and practical
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: skills to produce a complete functioning system. It requires application of engineering sciences, with given
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: tasks, and taking into account economic, engineering ethics and good practices. Modules related to design
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: and synthesis will be demonstrated as a mini-project, with case studies completed in the Project Construction
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 175 and Project Design 376 modules.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Engineering Practice:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Engineering  practice  involves  the  application  of  engineering  skills  to  solve  defined  engineering
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: problems through acquired skills in the workshop practices and series of practical classes in engineering
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: science and discipline-specific modules.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Essential Embedded Learning:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The  acquired  soft  skills  with  their  theoretical  engineering  science  connect  the  students  with  work-related
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: experience.  These  include  sustainability  aspects;  safety,  health,  environmental  and  other  professional
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: issues  such  as  ethics.  Students  will  also  develop  general  skills  that  will  be  of  value  in  a  wide  range  of
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: entrepreneurial activities. These include the development of abilities within problem solving, communication,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: effective  working  with  others, effective  use  of IT, report  writing,  information  retrieval, presentational  skills,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: project  planning,  self-learning,  performance  improvement,  and  awareness  of  the  benefits  of  continuing
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The WIL component of the programme will be conducted in the third year, with a minimum duration of 600
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: hours. The credit value allocated to the WIL component is 60 credits and continuously assessed by the qualified
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ADVANCED DIPLOMA IN COMPUTER SYSTEMS ENGINEERING
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The purpose of the programme:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The Advanced Diploma in Computer Systems Engineering is primarily an industry-oriented programme.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The programme provides students with a sound knowledge base in the field of Computer Systems Engineering.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The programme is designed to empower students to be able to apply their knowledge and skills to a particular
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: career or professional context, while equipping them to undertake more specialised and intensive learning.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Qualifications leading to this programme tend to have a strong professional or career focus and holders of
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: this programme are normally prepared to enter a specific niche in the Computer Systems Engineering, system
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: integration, digital electronics and other allied industries.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The purpose of educational programmes designed to meet this qualification is to build the necessary knowledge,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: understanding,  abilities  and  skills  required  for  further  learning  towards  becoming  a  competent  practicing
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: engineering technologist or certificated engineer. This programme provides:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Preparation for careers in engineering and areas that potentially benefit from engineering skills,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: for achieving technical proficiency and to make a contribution to the economy and national develop-
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ment.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The educational base required for registration as a Professional Engineering Technologist and/or
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Certificated Engineer with ECSA.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Entry to NQF level 8 programmes e.g. honours, post graduate diploma and bachelors programmes
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: and then to proceed to masters programmes.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Since the programme is designed to address the skills shortage in the country, bridge the curriculum gap
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: with respect to education, students are exposed to the work requirement after graduation, and to become
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: relevant for future career challenges. The purpose-driven curriculum designed for the Advanced Diploma in
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Computer Systems Engineering is aligned with the ECSA Exit Level Outcomes (ELO) contained in the ECSA
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: NQF 7 standard and all graduates of the programme must be competent in all outcomes. Computer systems
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: engineers are often tasked to research, design, develop, and test computer systems and components such
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: as  processors,  circuit  boards,  memory  devices,  networks,  and  routers.  In  addition  students  discover  new
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: directions in computer-related fields, which generate rapid advances in computer technology.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]
