text: POSTGRADUATE DIPLOMA IN COMPUTER SYSTEMS ENGINEERING
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The purpose of the programme:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Recent advancements in computer systems engineering are the base for the future industrial evolutions and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: the smart world. The feasibility of future developments strongly relies on the development of manpower in
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: the field of computer systems engineering who will be able to show competence in hardware, software and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: interfacing systems.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The need to develop and train manpower that will be able to advance the field of computer systems engineering
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: is imperative for the country and globally. Currently, the country has a shortage of postgraduate candidates,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: especially in the field of engineering. Since the demand for  postgraduates in industry, governmental parastatals
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: and the world at large has grown tremendously, the Department of Computer Systems Engineering took the
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: initiative to design a Postgraduate Diploma in Computer Systems Engineering. This programme is designed
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: to  address  the  highly  skilled  shortage  in  the  country  and  globally  in  the  emerging  digital  market,  and  to
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: develop the research and innovative skills of the students, empowering them in entrepreneurial and project
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: management capabilities.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The programme is offered to students with a technical background in preparation for careers in industry and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: academic research. This program further exposes students to state-of-the-art miniaturised and mobile computer
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: systems and smart device technology, allowing them to acquire the complementary hardware and software
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: knowledge and skills required for understanding and designing such systems. In this degree program, students
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: typically complete industrial research projects, giving them the chance to delve into real-world scenarios in
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: the field of Computer Systems Engineering.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: In addition to the industrial research project-based component requirement, students complete modules such
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: as: Advanced Artificial Intelligent Systems, Advanced Embedded Systems Design, and Advanced Digital Signal
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Processing. There is a range of electives that address the industrial needs, such as Advanced Intelligent
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Industrial Systems, Advanced Computer Architecture and Organisation, Advanced Intelligent Electromechanical
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Systems, Advanced Computer Emerging Technologies and Advanced Computer Networks.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Graduates are often qualified for careers in consumer electronics, telecommunications, networking, system
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: integration,  consulting  firms,  Biomedical  industries,  government,  the  electronic  gaming  industry,  artificial
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: intelligence and the software industry. They can also find opportunities in the information technology division of
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: a variety of businesses. Job titles could include testing senior technologist, senior systems analyst, hardware
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: technologist, information technology consultant, digital programmer and research officer.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  Graduate attribute 1: Problem-solving
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Apply engineering principles to systematically diagnose and solve broadly-defined engineering problems.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  Graduate attribute 2: Application of Scientific and Engineering Knowledge
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science and engineering sciences to the defined and applied
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: engineering  procedures,  processes,  systems  and  methodologies  to  solve  broadly-defined  engineering
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: problems.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  Graduate attribute 3: Engineering Design
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Perform procedural and non-procedural design of broadly-defined components, systems, works, products
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: or processes to meet desired needs normally within applicable standards, codes of practice and legisla-
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: tion.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  Graduate attribute 4: Investigation
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Conduct investigations of broadly-defined problems through locating, searching and selecting relevant
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: data  from  codes,  databases  and  literature,  designing  and  conducting  experiments,  analysing  and
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: interpreting results to provide valid conclusions.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  Graduate attribute 5: Engineering Methods, Skills, Tools, including Information Technology
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Use appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering tools, including information technology,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: prediction and modelling, for the solution of broadly-defined engineering problems, with an understanding
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: of the limitations, restrictions, premises, assumptions and constraints.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  Graduate attribute 6: Professional and Technical Communication
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with engineering audiences and the affected parties.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  Graduate attribute 7: Impact of Engineering Activity
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Demonstrate  knowledge  and  understanding  of  the  impact  of  engineering  activity  on  society,  eco-
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: nomy, industrial and physical environment, and address issues by analysis and evaluation.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  Graduate attribute 8: Individual and Teamwork
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and apply these to
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team and to manage projects.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  Graduate attribute 9: Independent Learning
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Engage in independent and life-long learning through well-developed learning skills.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Comprehend and apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, responsibilities and norms
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: of engineering technology practice.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: a.  Admission requirement(s):
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A  National  Diploma:  Engineering:  Computer  Systems,  or  a  National  Diploma:  Information
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Technology in the field of Intelligent Industrial Systems, or a National Diploma: Engineering:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Electrical (Electronics), or a Diploma in Computer Systems Engineering, or a relevant bachelor's
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: degree, or an equivalent qualification at NQF Level 6 with a minimum of 360 credits.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Holders  of  any  other  equivalent  South  African  or  international  qualification  may  also  be
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: considered, see Chapter 1 of Students’ Rules and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: b.  Selection criteria:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Admission is subject to selection. Prospective students will be evaluated based on the marks
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: obtained in their previous qualification and/or work experience.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Acceptance is subject to available capacity according to the Student Enrolment Plan (SEP).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Applicants will be informed of their status per an official letter from the Office of the Registrar,
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: alternatively, they can check their application status on the TUT website, www.tut.ac.za.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: c.  Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), equivalence and status:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Information on the rules and the process to follow is available in Chapter 30 of Students’ Rules
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Intake for the qualification:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: January only.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: e.  Presentation:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Day classes offered on Saturdays over a period of two years.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: f.   Minimum duration:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A minimum of one or two years (depending on the programme presentation).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: g.  Exclusion and readmission:
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: See Chapter 2 of Students’ Rules and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The option to re-register for Engineering Project Design is subject to a student’s academic
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: performance. The purpose of the re-registration option is to provide students with an opportu-
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: nity to complete the final project only, and not to redo the whole module should they fail the
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: module.
section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["FACULTY OF INFORMATION AND\nCOMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Please Note:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 1.  Although the information in this Prospectus has been compiled as accurately as possible, the Council
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: accepts no responsibility for any inaccuracies in this publication. This Prospectus is valid for 2026 only.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 2.  Life Orientation and an achievement Level of 1 in a subject are not considered in the calculation of the
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Admission Point Score (APS).
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 3.  Prospective students will not be admitted to any qualification without prior evaluation.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 4.  The indicated non-refundable administration fee and certified copies of the applicant's identity document,
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Senior  Certificate/National  Senior  Certificate  and  all  other  relevant  documents  must  accompany  the
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: completed application form or online application.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 5.  The closing dates for admissions are available on the University website.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 6.  A student must complete a qualification at the learning site where he/she was accepted and is registered.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A transfer between sites will only be allowed if the student follows the following process:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A formal request must be submitted to the academic manager/Head of the Department on the
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: current learning site before the second Friday in May (to be considered for transfer in July of the
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: same year) or the second  Friday in  October (to be  considered  for a transfer in January of the
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: following year). The request must contain the reasons for the transfer.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A committee will meet shortly after each of the closing dates for submissions to consider every
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: request on merit, keeping in mind the availability of space and the adherence to enrolment quotas
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: on respective learning sites. Students will be informed of the outcome.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Important:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: TUT admission requirements for entry-level programmes adhere to national legislation, and therefore, the
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: following are required:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Bachelor’s degrees: at least four subjects at performance level 4.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: •  Diplomas: at least four subjects at performance level 3.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Applicants must verify the specific requirements for each programme as indicated in the Prospectus.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ACCEPTANCE IS SUBJECT TO AVAILABLE CAPACITY ACCORDING TO THE STUDENT
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ENROLMENT PLAN (SEP)
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: it is recommended that the application process be initiated while the application for the certificate is in
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: process.

section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: a.  Admission requirement(s):
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: An Advanced Diploma, or a Bachelor's degree, or a Baccalaureus Technologiae in Business
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Administration  or Administrative  Management  or  Management  Services,  or  an  equivalent
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: qualification at NQF Level 7. Candidates must have an average of 55% or more for the final-
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: year modules.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Holders  of  any  other  equivalent  South  African  or  international  qualification  may  also  be
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: considered, see Chapter 1 of Students’ Rules and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: b.  Selection criteria:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: All candidates with an NQF Level 7 qualification in a Business or Management-related field
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: must have at least four years work experience. All candidates with an NQF Level 7 qualification
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: in a non-business or management-related field must have at least four years of management
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: or supervisory experience.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Candidates  will  be  required  to  complete  an  online  assessment  test. The Tshwane  School
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: for  Business  and  Society  (TSB)  uses  Top  Talent  Solutions  (TTS)  for  this  purpose.  It
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: is required that a candidate completes the TTS online assessment, which includes an online
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: video interview, and reach a satisfactory score. Results from the NMAT (National Management
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Aptitude Test) are also accepted. Applicants who can provide proof that they have taken and
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: passed the NMAT in the past three years will be exempted from doing the TTS assessment.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The closing date for admission is 30 September. Admission is subject to selection and will
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: take place in two stages:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: 50% of the applications received will be selected from candidates with completed qualifi-
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: cations and will be evaluated and ranked according to the previous related qualification.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The remaining 50% will be selected from candidates still waiting for their final results and
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: will be evaluated and ranked according to the previous related qualification when it is
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: achieved.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Acceptance is subject to available capacity according to the Student Enrolment Plan (SEP).
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Applicants will be informed of their status per an official letter from the Office of the Registrar,
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: alternatively, they can check their application status on the TUT website, www.tut.ac.za.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: c.  Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), equivalence and status:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The criteria for RPL are as follows:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  At least five (5) years or more of management experience on a middle or senior manage
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: ment level;
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  A score of 4 or more in TTS Psychometric Battery Selection Test; and
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  A successful interview with the TSB.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Further information on the rules and the process to follow is available in Chapter 30 of Students’
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Rules and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: January only.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: e.  Presentation:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Block-mode classes offered on Saturdays from 07:00 to 14:30, and evening classes during
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: the week.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: f.  Minimum duration:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: One year.

section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: a.  Admission requirement(s):
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A professional bachelor's degree, or a bachelor honours degree, or a postgraduate diploma,
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: or an equivalent qualification on NQF Level 8. Applicants should have a minimum of five (5)
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: years of working experience.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Holders  of  any  other  equivalent  South  African  or  international  qualification  may  also  be
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: considered, see Chapter 1 of Students’ Rules and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Candidates with a South African NQF Level 7 or an equivalent academic qualification from
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: recognised local or international academic institutions, may also be considered, but should
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: apply for Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL).
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: b.  Selection criteria:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: All candidates for admission into the MBA programme will be required to complete an online
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: assessment  test  as  part  of  the  selection  process.  The  Tshwane  School  for  Business  and
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Society (TSB) uses Top Talent Solutions (TTS) for this purpose.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: It is required that a candidate completes the TTS online assessment, which includes an online
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: video interview, and reach a satisfactory score.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Results from the NMAT (National Management Aptitude Test) are also accepted. Applicants
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: who can provide proof that they have taken and passed the NMAT in the past three years will
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: be exempted from doing the TTS assessment.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Acceptance is subject to available capacity according to the Student Enrolment Plan (SEP) as
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: well as supervisory capacity. Applicants will be informed of their status per an official letter
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: from the Office of the Registrar, alternatively, they can check their application status on the
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: TUT website, www.tut.ac.za.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: c.  Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), equivalence and status:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: The criteria for RPL are as follows:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  At least five (5) years or more of management experience on a senior level;
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  A score of 4 or more in TTS Psychometric Battery Selection Test; and
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: -  A successful interview with the TSB.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Further information on the rules and the process to follow is available in Chapter 30 of Students’
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Rules and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Intake for the qualification:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: January only for Pretoria Campus and multiple intakes for the online presentation. Please
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: contact the Academic Department for further information on intake dates.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: e.  Presentation:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Block-mode classes, research and online presentation. The block-mode classes are offered
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: in  trimesters  in  the  form  of  compulsory  lectures.  Classes  are  held  from  07:00  to  14:30  on
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Saturdays and evening classes during the week.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Duration:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A minimum of two years and a maximum of four years.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: g.  Exclusion and readmission:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: See Chapter 2 of Students’ Rules and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: a.  Admission requirement(s):
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A Master's Degree in Business Administration (MBA), or an equivalent Master’s degree in
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Management, where the candidate has completed the degree with a mark of 60% or more.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: considered, see Chapter 1 of Students’ Rules and Regulations (Part 1 of the Prospectus).

text: b.  Selection criteria:
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Submission of a preliminary doctoral proposal that complies with the protocol set by the
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: University and the Tshwane School for Business and Society.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: If  the  preliminary  doctoral  proposal  is  acceptable,  the  candidate  will  be  invited  to  register
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: for an Advanced Research Methodology module at the Tshwane School for Business and Society.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Successful  completion  of  the  Advanced  Research  Methodology  module  is  compulsory.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: A candidate can apply to be exempted from this module if he/she has successfully completed
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: a full master’s dissertation or doctoral thesis in a previous study, or if proof is provided to the
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Tshwane  School  for  Business  and  Society  that  the  candidate  was  exposed  to  research
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: methodology learning with the same outcomes and at the same level as that of the module.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: If the candidate is successful in completing the Advanced Research Methodology, the candi-
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: date will be invited to defend the proposal at a panel organised by the Tshwane School for
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Business and Society where the final suitability of the study and the candidate will be determined.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: Acceptance is subject to available capacity according to the Student Enrolment Plan (SEP)
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: as well as supervisory capacity. Applicants will be informed of their status per an official letter
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: from the Office of the Registrar, alternatively, they can check their application status on the
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]

text: TUT website, www.tut.ac.za.
section_path: ["TSHWANE SCHOOL FOR BUSINESS AND \nSOCIETY", "PARTS OF THE PROSPECTUS"]
